__ui_group_compile_expert_collapsed: Advanced compile strategy controls are collapsed. Turn on performance expert mode to expose them.
__ui_group_dora_variant_common: DoRA is not a standalone algorithm but an enhancement stacked on plain LoRA: weights split into direction and magnitude. The backend injector resolves LyCORIS before DoRA, so stacking switches never take effect on LyCORIS routes.
__ui_group_dora_variant_frontier: DoRA is not a standalone algorithm: it stacks on the native networks.lora route, splitting weights into direction and magnitude. LyCORIS algorithms and other entity injectors do not support stacking; the wizard hosts a single switch in its enhancement area.
__ui_group_entity_injectors: One linear layer carries exactly one Delta-W entity: when several are enabled only the highest-priority one wins. DoRA is excluded — it is a stacked enhancement with its own group below.
__ui_group_lokr_params: Only shown under LoKr: Kronecker factorization mode, dual-side decomposition, full-matrix fallback and other heavy structural controls.
__ui_group_lycoris_regularization: LyCORIS-specific dropout / regularization knobs. Keep defaults for most runs.
__ui_group_lycoris_structure: Parameters that define the LyCORIS network skeleton: algorithm, conv dims and preset. Safe to ignore on plain LoRA routes.
__ui_group_prefix_protection: These keys bound where drop/shuffle may act: keep_tokens prefixes or separator heads can be excluded from mutation (consumed by dataset_caption_policy / output_caption_fragments).
ac_auto_lr_scale_factor: Internal scale factor applied by the auto learning-rate adjuster; not user-facing.
ac_clip_drift_danger: CLIP-drift intervention threshold (e.g. lowering LR). Recommended: keep 0.05.
ac_early_stopping_patience: Steps without improvement before early stop. Recommended: 5-20 by noise level.
ac_early_stopping_threshold: Minimum change counted as improvement. Keep default sensitivity.
ac_enable_auto_lr_adjustment: Auto-tunes LR toward GSNR/loss targets. Evaluate against a manual-LR baseline.
ac_enable_auto_te_freeze: Freezes TE automatically at a set step; handy late in long runs to save memory.
ac_enable_dynamic_loss_scaling: Dynamic loss scaling driven by grad norms; helps unstable fp16 runs.
ac_enable_smart_early_stopping: Stops automatically when loss stalls for long. Good unattended-run insurance.
ac_enable_smart_lr_decay: Decays LR on plateaus; pairs well with early stopping.
ac_enabled: AutoController auto-adjusts LR, early stop and TE freezing from run signals (legacy lulynx_auto_controller_* still accepted). Baseline first, then enable.
ac_loss_plateau_window: Sliding window defining a plateau. Recommended: 50.
ac_lr_decay_factor: LR multiplier applied on decay. Recommended: 0.5.
ac_max_decays: Maximum number of LR decays. Recommended: keep 3.
ac_stable_rank_collapse_threshold: Stable-rank drop ratio treated as collapse. Recommended: keep 0.3.
ac_target_gsnr: Target gradient-SNR steering automatic LR changes. Recommended: ~5.
ac_target_loss: Target loss for auto LR (0 disables target tracking).
ac_te_freeze_step: Step when TE auto-freeze triggers; about half your total steps works well.
ac_warmup_steps: Observation steps before the controller acts. Recommended: ~100.
acceleration_profile: Runs acceleration preflight and suggests a tier for the current model family.
activation_compression_dtype: Activation compression dtype: fp16/bf16 safe; fp8_e4m3 halves further but lossy. Start with bf16.
activation_compression_enabled: Compresses activations during backward (fp16/bf16 near-lossless, fp8 lossy). Start with bf16 when VRAM is marginal.
activation_compression_min_tensor_mb: Only tensors above this MB get compressed; smaller ones are not worth it. Recommended: 1.
activation_cpu_offload_enabled: Moves large activations to host RAM; combinable with chunked checkpointing as the next VRAM lever.
activation_cpu_offload_min_tensor_mb: Offload threshold in MB for activations. Recommended: >=1 MB.
activation_cpu_offload_pool_gb: Pinned host pool in GB for faster DMA transfers. Recommended: 1-8.
adalora_enabled: AdaLoRA redistributes rank budget by SVD sensitivity across layers; slower but adapts capacity.
adalora_init_rank: AdaLoRA starting rank; 0 uses 1.5x target. Recommended: keep 0 for automatic.
adalora_mask_interval: Steps between rank-mask updates. Recommended: ~100; too frequent oscillates.
adalora_orth_reg_weight: Orthogonality regularization weight preventing rank collapse. Recommended: ~0.5.
adalora_target_rank: Final AdaLoRA target rank; 0 follows network_dim. Recommended: keep 0 for consistency.
adalora_total_steps: Total steps for budget scheduling; 0 follows max_train_steps. Recommended: keep 0.
adapter_init_export_mode: Export handling for special inits: auto converts to a base-loadable LoRA at save time. Keep auto.
adapter_init_strategy: Unified init entry: default standard; pissa/olora/loftq special inits inside the request pipeline. Keep default; pick pissa for faster convergence.
adapter_mask_pruning_ema_decay: EMA decay for weight*grad importance. Recommended: keep 0.9.
adapter_mask_pruning_enabled: Masks low-contribution ranks during training based on importance scores. Useful against overfitting or for slimmer outputs.
adapter_mask_pruning_interval: Steps between mask updates. Recommended: around the default 100.
adapter_mask_pruning_min_rank: Minimum ranks kept per adapter. Recommended: suggested 1-4.
adapter_mask_pruning_target_ratio: Final masked-ratio target (0.5 keeps about half). Recommended: probe below 0.5; default 0 prunes nothing.
adapter_mask_pruning_warmup_steps: Importance-only warmup before masking starts. Recommended: short or zero is fine.
adapter_target_policy: How FG-LoRA picks target layers; all by default, scored filtering for fine control.
adapter_target_policy_fraction: Fraction of layers kept by score. Recommended: start at 1.
adapter_target_policy_min_score: Filter out layers scoring below this; 0 keeps all. Recommended: keep 0.
adapter_target_policy_profile_path: Pre-computed FG-LoRA profile JSON; required for non-all policies, otherwise all targets are used as fallback.
adapter_target_policy_top_k: Keep exactly this many top layers; 0 uses fraction mode. Recommended: keep 0.
adapter_type: Newbie adapter kind mapped onto the native LoRA route. Keep lora; others are reserved entries.
adaptive_caching_ema_momentum: EMA smoothing for change rates. Recommended: keep 0.9.
adaptive_caching_enabled: Aircon skips blocks by change-rate signals, orthogonal to sigma-depth scheduling. For speed-tolerant experiments.
adaptive_caching_min_blocks_computed: Hard minimum of fully computed blocks per step. Recommended: 4.
adaptive_caching_threshold_base: Baseline change-rate threshold; higher skips less. Recommended: tune around 0.1.
adaptive_caching_threshold_decay: Threshold decay over timesteps (looser at high sigma). Recommended: keep 0.5.
adaptive_loss_weighting_enabled: Learnable SNR gamma replacing fixed min-SNR. Compare against fixed gamma 5.
adaptive_loss_weighting_init_gamma: Initial learnable gamma. Recommended: start at 5 like min-SNR.
adaptive_loss_weighting_lr: LR for the learnable gamma. Recommended: small steps around 1e-3.
adaptive_noise_scale: Scales extra noise_offset by mean |latent| so bright images get positive offset. Recommended: 10-50% of noise_offset (e.g. 0.01); requires noise_offset > 0.
adaptive_rank_ema_decay: Sensitivity EMA decay; higher smooths more. Recommended: keep 0.9.
adaptive_rank_enabled: Allocate module ranks under a fixed budget from sensitivity probes; off keeps uniform rank.
adaptive_rank_locked_modules_json: JSON list of modules whose ranks are locked against adaptive changes.
adaptive_rank_max_rank: Recommended: per-module rank ceiling; keep within network_dim.
adaptive_rank_min_delta: Skip migrations smaller than this delta to avoid shape churn. Recommended: keep 1.
adaptive_rank_mode: Per-module dynamic rank policy; static assigns up front, dynamic migrates with evidence. Start off.
adaptive_rank_probe_window: Gradient observations needed for stable sensitivity. Recommended: keep 32.
adaptive_rank_profile_json: Static adaptive-rank profile JSON (empty for dynamic mode).
adaptive_rank_reallocation_interval: Reallocation cadence in steps for dynamic mode. Recommended: keep 100.
adaptive_rank_total_budget: Global cap on summed ranks; 0 keeps the current budget. Recommended: keep 0.
adaptive_rank_warmup_steps: Sample-only warmup before migrating ranks. Recommended: short or zero is fine.
adaptive_sample_mining_interval: Steps between sample-loss aggregation passes. Recommended: keep 10.
adaptive_sample_mining_max_samples: Capacity of tracked sample states. Recommended: keep 2048.
adaptive_sample_mining_report_limit: Max rows in the mining report. Recommended: keep 32.
adaptive_sample_mining_top_fraction: Fraction of samples flagged hard. Recommended: keep 0.25.
adaptive_step_logging_enabled: Auto-throttles progress/log writes when they dominate step time. Keep on for long runs (default).
adaptive_step_logging_threshold: Log-time share of step time above which throttling kicks in. Recommended: ~0.01.
adaptive_training_adjustments: Which knobs the controller may touch. Advisory mode only records proposals; automatic mode still has to clear the evidence threshold, the configured bounds and the locked-item list. Start with learning rate alone.
adaptive_training_enabled: Off keeps classic fixed-schedule training with no controller attached; on lets you pick advisory or constrained-automatic adjustment. Leave off unless you want the controller in the loop.
adaptive_training_event_history: Events kept in memory/resume state. Recommended: keep 256.
adaptive_training_interval_steps: Min steps between controller evaluations. Recommended: keep 50.
adaptive_training_learning_rate_max: Upper clamp for automatic LR. Recommended: keep 1.0.
adaptive_training_learning_rate_min: Lower clamp for automatic LR. Recommended: keep 1e-8.
adaptive_training_learning_rate_step: Multiplicative shrink factor per adjustment (0.01-1). Recommended: gentle 0.8 recommended.
adaptive_training_locked_items: Items the controller may never touch. Lock anything you hand-tuned deliberately.
adaptive_training_max_actions: Max controller actions per run. Recommended: keep 8.
adaptive_training_metrics_enabled: Streams loss/region-loss/grad-norm metric events. Keep on (default).
adaptive_training_metrics_interval: Metric event sampling cadence in steps. Recommended: keep 1.
adaptive_training_minimum_evidence: Evidence reports required before acting. Recommended: keep 3.
adaptive_training_objective: Controller objective profile; balanced fits most.
adaptive_training_patience: Consecutive quality declines before corrective action. Recommended: keep 2.
adaptive_training_region_weight_max: Ceiling for region weights. Recommended: suggested 4.
adaptive_training_region_weight_min: Floor for region weights. Recommended: suggested 0.1.
adaptive_training_region_weight_step: Adjustment step for region weights. Recommended: suggested 0.1.
adaptive_training_rollback_on_decline: Reverts recent reversible actions when validation drops. Keep true.
adaptive_training_strategy: Adaptive training controller strategy (manual / auto LR / full auto).
advanced_monitoring_enabled: Collects advanced runtime metrics. On while debugging, off for throughput.
advanced_optimizer_strategy: Advanced optimizer strategy hook: auto decides; specific strategies opt in. Keep auto.
advanced_stats_enabled: Extra statistics in logs. Diagnostic use.
albumentations_enabled: Enable a custom albumentations pipeline defined as JSON. For users familiar with the library; bad configs break runs.
albumentations_pipeline: The albumentations pipeline JSON. Start from official examples and validate stepwise.
allow_tokenizer_only_clip: Permit tokenizer-only CLIP/Jina resources (tokenization only). Enable only with full awareness of the limitation.
alpha_adaln: Alpha scaling for the AdaLN group. Recommended: keep 1.
alpha_cross_attn: Alpha scaling for the Cross-Attention group. Recommended: keep 1.
alpha_llm_adapter: Alpha scaling for the LLM-adapter group. Recommended: keep 1.
alpha_mask: Use the PNG alpha channel as the loss mask. Ideal for transparent-background assets focusing on subjects.
alpha_mlp: Alpha scaling for the MLP group. Recommended: keep 1.
alpha_self_attn: Alpha scaling for the Self-Attention group. Recommended: keep 1.
anima_auto_scan_folder: Anima model directory; auto-fill DiT / VAE / related paths when possible.
anima_block_checkpointing: Primary Anima checkpointing: recomputes per-DiT-block in backward, saving more than generic checkpointing. Prefer over the generic knob.
anima_block_checkpointing_interval: Checkpoint density across DiT blocks: 1 recomputes everything (leanest); 2 doubles activation VRAM for ~13% speedup. Recommended: use 1 below 16 GB, try 2 above.
anima_block_checkpointing_mode: block recomputes whole blocks and measured both faster and lighter on Anima — keep it. selective recomputes only elementwise ops and keeps matmul/SDPA; in theory it recomputes less, but on Anima it does not win (slightly slower and higher VRAM), so it rarely needs changing.
anima_block_offload_enabled: LRU-offload keeps N Anima blocks resident and rotates the rest: complements checkpointing when VRAM-bound without recompute.
anima_block_offload_gpu_slots: Resident block slots on GPU (current + window). Recommended: 3; fewer slots save more VRAM.
anima_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Async prefetch depth per phase. Recommended: 1.
anima_block_prefetch: Asynchronously prefetches upcoming Anima blocks to hide swap latency. Pair with any offload scheme.
anima_block_prefetch_depth: Blocks to prefetch ahead. Recommended: 1-2; more costs VRAM.
anima_block_prefetch_mode: Prefetch style: fixed-depth original or adaptive. Start original.
anima_block_residency: Freeze DiT Weight CPU Memory Low VRAM.
anima_block_residency_min_params: Same threshold for Anima frozen Linears; 0 keeps all eligible. Recommended: keep 0.
anima_cache_build_batch_size: Samples encoded per cache-build batch. Recommended: 8; halve on OOM.
anima_cache_build_prefetch: A CPU worker pre-decodes the next image chunk during cache build: faster with one extra host copy. Enable with spare RAM.
anima_cache_resize_max_edge: Long-edge cap in shortest mode; 0 auto-sets 2x target resolution. Recommended: keep 0.
anima_cache_resize_mode: Cache resize mode: longest-edge align, shortest-edge cap, or freefit no-upscale. Keep longest.
anima_cache_target_resolution: Cache-side target edge: 0 follows training resolution, negative keeps source size, positive sets explicit edge. Recommended: keep 0.
anima_cached_text_token_limit: Cached-path truncation; 0 caches full length. Recommended: keep 0.
anima_cached_training: Required by startup checks when cache_first / force_cache_only is selected.
anima_controlnet_cond_dim: Intermediate width of the condition-image encoder. Recommended: keep 64.
anima_controlnet_cond_emb_dim: Shared conditioning embed dimension. Recommended: keep 32.
anima_controlnet_cond_resblocks: Residual blocks in the condition trunk; 0 disables. Recommended: keep 1.
anima_controlnet_dropout: Dropout after the mid projection. Recommended: keep 0.
anima_controlnet_mlp_dim: Hidden width for down/mid/up and FiLM layers. Recommended: keep 64.
anima_controlnet_multiplier: Global scale on injected condition residuals. Recommended: 0.5-1.
anima_controlnet_target_layers: Which DiT Linears receive Anima-ControlNet injections. Start with the default self_attn_q hook.
anima_controlnet_use_aspp: Multi-scale ASPP pooling helps dense/global structures like depth; skip for line art.
anima_controlnet_weights: Leave empty to train from scratch; can load Anima weights in community-readable layouts.
anima_cross_attn_lr: Standalone Cross-Attention LR; 0 follows base. Recommended: halve it if text influence dominates.
anima_depth_expansion_enabled: Depth up-scaling interleaves copies of adjacent blocks with zeroed output projections; Anima full finetune only. Deliberate use only.
anima_depth_expansion_target_layers: Recommended: target depth after expansion; must exceed the base count (40 fits a 28-layer base).
anima_depth_expansion_train_scope: What trains after expansion: new_layers matches classic DUS; peripheral adds input/time/output shells. Keep new_layers.
anima_ema_feat_align_decay: Decay of the EMA shadow. Recommended: keep 0.9999.
anima_ema_feat_align_enabled: Self-distills features against an EMA-of-LoRA shadow. Experimental comparison aid.
anima_faithful_degrade_policy: What happens when faithful forward is requested against a checkpoint with a frozen llm_adapter but the prerequisites are missing (cache without t5_input_ids, or an incompatible seam left on): fail refuses to start (default, because the checkpoint was never trained in the legacy conditioning space and the run would only emit noise), warn degrades after a notice. Keep fail; pick warn only for a deliberate legacy-path comparison.
anima_faithful_forward: Uses the faithful native Anima DiT forward matching the reference implementation. Keep true; off is for perf experiments.
anima_fixed_qwen3_tokens: Recommended: pin Qwen3 hidden length; 0 dynamic.
anima_fixed_t5_tokens: Recommended: pin T5 id length; 0 dynamic.
anima_fixed_text_tokens: Pin text token length for static shapes; 0 keeps dynamic. Recommended: relevant only for static compile routes.
anima_fixed_visual_tokens: Recommended: pin visual token count; 0 keeps cached sizes.
anima_fused_qkv: Fused Q/K/V projection kernels for Anima self-attention. Enable after stability checks.
anima_guidance_scale: Anima training-side guidance scale, forwarded as a fixed value; not user-facing.
anima_llm_adapter_lr: Recommended: standalone LLM-adapter LR (applies when anima_train_llm_adapter is on); 0 follows base.
anima_mixed_loss_mask_policy: Policy when masked and unmasked samples share a batch; full_sample treats unmasked images whole. Keep full_sample.
anima_mlp_lr: Recommended: standalone MLP-group LR; 0 follows base.
anima_mod_lr: Recommended: standalone AdaLN-modulation LR; 0 follows base.
anima_model_prediction_type: Prediction target: velocity (standard), noise/epsilon, or clean-sample. Must match your base model; keep velocity.
anima_progressive_full_finetune_enabled: Progressively unfreezes DiT blocks toward full finetune as VRAM allows; use once LoRA plateaus and memory permits.
anima_rematerializable_block_enabled: Rematerializable-block prototype (profile-only). For diagnostics rather than regular training.
anima_rematerializable_block_mode: Only profile_only exists today. Keep it.
anima_self_attn_lr: Standalone Self-Attention group LR; 0 follows the base LR. Recommended: keep 0 unless a group misbehaves.
anima_sigmoid_scale: Compression factor of the sigmoid timestep distribution. Recommended: around default 1 (range 0.1-5).
anima_text_token_limit: Online-path truncation for Qwen3/T5; 0 disables. Recommended: nonzero values are smoke/debug aids only.
anima_train_adaln: Inject AdaLN modulation projections; common for character/style weight. Keep on (default).
anima_train_cross_attn: Inject Cross-Attention to strengthen image-text alignment. Keep on when text binding is weak.
anima_train_llm_adapter: Trains the extra LLM-adapter branch beyond ordinary Anima LoRA. Advanced path; baseline plain LoRA first.
anima_train_mlp: Inject MLP layers for extra capacity. Good with larger datasets; can overfit tiny ones.
anima_train_self_attn: Inject LoRA into Self-Attention (q/k/v/out). Keep on; primary learning surface.
anima_vram_optimizer: Anima packed/varlen memory optimization intent. Only takes effect with the FlashAttention 2 backend; enabling it requests packed varlen attention and picks the most memory-frugal checkpointing automatically. If the resolved runtime backend is not FlashAttention 2 it degrades automatically and logs the reason.
anima_weighting_scheme: Loss weighting scheme; empty = none, uniform is an accepted legacy alias for none. Choose sigma-weighted variants deliberately.
ant_blend: Blend between adaptive and uniform sampling (1 fully adaptive). Recommended: keep 0.7.
ant_ema_decay: EMA decay of per-bin losses. Recommended: keep 0.95.
ant_enabled: ANT reshapes timestep sampling from per-bin loss EMA. Try when some bands lag.
ant_num_bins: Sigma bins for the controller. Recommended: keep 50.
ant_temperature: Flattens (>1) or sharpens (<1) sampling weights. Recommended: keep 1.
ant_warmup_updates: Uniform updates until statistics stabilize. Recommended: keep 30.
anyflow_cfg_bake: AnyFlow-specific CFG bake toggle. For controlled comparisons.
anyflow_student_steps: AnyFlow-specific student steps overriding the generic field. Recommended: use 4.
anyflow_x0_endpoint_weight: Weight of x0 endpoint matching; 0 off. Not an accelerator. Recommended: keep 0.
apply_t5_attn_mask: T5 Attention Better Handle Variable-length Text
attention_backend: Force an attention backend (auto follows the environment). Explicit values are for compatibility debugging.
attn_mode: Attention implementation; explicit picks write through to attention_backend. Note VRAM optimizers only engage on FlashAttention 2. Keep auto.
auto_prodigy_max_update_rms_ratio: Cap on update RMS relative to weight RMS. Recommended: keep 0.01.
auto_prodigy_profile: AutoProdigy profile: safe conservative, balanced default, aggressive. Use balanced; drop to safe if unstable.
auto_prodigy_safeguard_warmup: Protect the adaptive step during warmup. Keep on.
base_model_path: SDXL checkpoint Or diffusers Model Directory.
base_weights: Merge Base Model LoRA Path, Path
batch_size: Batch size for smoke runs; true smoke testing currently allows only 1. Recommended: keep 1.
block_lr_zero_threshold: Blocks whose weight falls below this are fully zeroed. Recommended: give 0.01 to hard-disable a section.
block_merge_size: Blocks per merged group in merged_block mode. Recommended: 2.
block_swap_strategy: Swap transport strategy; auto resolves the best path per family. Keep auto.
blocks_to_swap: Number of U-Net/DiT blocks kept on CPU (0=off). Recommended: start 8-16 on 28-48 block DiTs; each extra block trades speed for VRAM.
bnb_4bit_compute_dtype: Compute dtype for bnb layers: bfloat16 recommended, float16 for older cards.
bnb_4bit_quant_storage: Storage dtype for quantized weights. Keep uint8.
bnb_4bit_quant_type: bnb 4-bit type: nf4 is informationally optimal; fp4 for older GPUs.
bnb_4bit_use_double_quant: Double quantization also compresses quantile constants (~0.4 bits/param saved). Keep on (default).
boogu_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Boogu blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
boogu_block_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum Boogu block size (MiB) eligible for offload.
boogu_block_offload_pin_memory: Pin host memory for Boogu block offload H2D.
boogu_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Boogu block offload.
boogu_control_image_max_pixels: VAE ref Encode Before cap, Default 1MP
boogu_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleaves copies of Boogu single-stream blocks and initializes the inserted layers as identity residuals; the run saves a complete new base model. Full finetune only, and deliberate use only.
boogu_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total single-stream transformer blocks after expansion. Recommended: above the native 32 of the Base checkpoint; 40 is a moderate step.
boogu_depth_expansion_train_scope: Trains the inserted layers only, the inserted layers plus the input/time/output periphery, or every parameter. new_layers mirrors classic depth up-scaling and is the safe choice.
boogu_load_mllm: Off by default so cached text embeddings are reused; enable only while building the cache or when encoding captions live, since it adds a sizeable RAM and VRAM footprint.
boogu_model_version: Boogu base-model version tag; mismatches load wrong weight layouts.
boogu_task: Boogu task kind (lora/edit...). Pick by desired artifact.
bp_low_enabled: BP-low downsamples backward passes at high noise to save VRAM. Fits high-res runs dominated by high sigma.
bp_low_factor: Downsampling factor (2 = half resolution). Recommended: range 2-4.
bp_low_noise_threshold: Enable downsampling above this sigma. Recommended: keep 0.5.
bp_low_scale: Sigma units: 1.0 raw [0,1], 1000 legacy scale. Recommended: match your schedule.
bp_low_schedule: Hard threshold vs cosine ramp. step is simplest.
bucket_custom_resos: One per line, e.g. 1024x1024. Leave empty to generate buckets automatically from the strategy above; once filled, this bucket table takes priority and the bucketing strategy no longer applies.
bucket_no_upscale: Never upscale smaller images to fit a bucket (only downscale larger). Enable with many small images to avoid blur from upsampling.
bucket_reso_steps: Bucket resolution granularity in px. Recommended: 64 standard; 32 in low-VRAM profiles.
bucket_selection_mode: Bucketing strategy: aspect (default), area-based, or legacy aliases equivalent to their canonical names. Keep aspect.
bypass_mode: Bypass mode skips part of the injection logic. DoRA stacking forces this off server-side; they cannot combine. Keep false.
cache_latents: Caches VAE latents to skip re-encoding every step: major speedup. Keep on unless you need online pixel-space augmentation.
cache_latents_to_disk: Persists latents to disk across runs: slower first pass, faster after. Enable for stable datasets on fast disks; incompatible with color aug.
cache_text_encoder_outputs: Caches TE outputs to save VRAM but freezes the text encoder entirely. On for frozen TE; must be off to train TE.
cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_disk: Persists TE outputs to disk across runs. Good for fixed captions; rebuild the cache after edits.
cached_collate_mode: Collate mode over cached data (Anima/Newbie cache-first only). auto is fine.
cached_dataloader_auto_policy: Auto-tunes workers/prefetch on cached routes, overriding manual values. Keep on (default).
cached_dataloader_pin_memory: Pin host memory for cached dataloader transfers (auto / true / false).
cached_dataloader_prefetch_factor: Prefetch factor per worker for the cached dataloader.
cached_dataloader_workers: Worker processes for the cached dataloader (0 = main process).
caption_dropout_every_n_epochs: Drops all captions for one epoch every N epochs. Recommended: prefer rate-based dropout; keep 0 here.
caption_dropout_rate: Probability the whole caption is dropped (unconditional learning). Recommended: 0-0.05; mainly for CFG-related training.
caption_extension: Caption file extension (.txt by default, same basename as image). Standardize on one or some images will silently lose captions.
caption_protect_prefix_from_dropout: Shield the prefix before the separator from dropout/shuffle. Enable for prefix|||body caption layouts.
caption_replacements: Caption rewrite table (old->new), regex-aware once enabled. Use sparingly for term normalization.
caption_replacements_regex: Interpret replacement rules as regex instead of literals. Enable only for pattern-based rules.
caption_source_empty_ratio: Share (%) of empty-text samples. Recommended: 5; too high hurts alignment.
caption_source_mix_enabled: Mixed Tag/NL sampling over structured JSON captions (Anima/Newbie). Off by default; on to blend triggers with natural language.
caption_source_nl_ratio: Share (%) emitting trigger + natural language. Recommended: 65 (NL-heavy generalizes better).
caption_source_trigger_only_ratio: Share (%) of samples that emit only the trigger word. Recommended: 10; ratios should sum to 100.
caption_tag_dropout_rate: Per-tag random dropout probability for robustness. Recommended: 0-0.05; triggers stay exempt via keep_tokens rules.
caption_tag_dropout_target_count: Tags dropped per image in random_n mode. Recommended: 1.
caption_tag_dropout_target_mode: How matched non-protected tags are handled: drop all, or randomly drop N. Keep drop_all.
caption_tag_dropout_targets: Tags eligible for dropout. One per line, comma-separated also supported.
caption_tag_mutate_scope: Which tags may change: all, or only after the separator (protected head prefix). Choose after_separator when using structured prefixes.
caption_tag_scope_separator: When scope=after_separator, split caption at this string; head is protected, tail is mutable. Default |||
caption_variant_loss_adaptive: Adapt variant sampling by per-variant loss. Experimental; baseline fixed ratios first.
caption_variant_ratio: Sampling share of non-primary variants. Recommended: 0.2-0.5.
caption_variants_enabled: Rotate multiple caption variants per image for paraphrase generalization.
cdka_allora: Module-level ALLoRA normalization for CDKA. Experimental.
cdka_enabled: CDKA: asymmetric Kronecker design with alpha scaling, improving KronA. Same use cases as KronA.
cdka_factor_in: CDKA input factor r2; 0 defaults to 8. Recommended: keep 0.
cdka_factor_out: CDKA output factor r1; 0 defaults to 2. Recommended: keep 0.
cdka_weight_decompose: DoRA magnitude decomposition on CDKA. Experimental; compare with baseline.
cfm_lambda: Weight of the contrastive flow-matching aux loss. Recommended: small start around 0.05.
checkpoint_policy: Checkpointing policy: auto balances, full maximizes savings, offloaded pages to CPU, selective targets specific blocks. Keep auto.
class_names: Detection class names, one per line; the order defines the class indices written into the dataset.
class_prompt: Class caption (e.g. photo of a person) for regularization images; contrasts with the instance trigger.
clear_dataset_npz_before_train: Workers wipe stale .npz caches before training to force a rebuild. Toggle once after big dataset changes.
clip_skip: Which CLIP layer from the top provides text features. Recommended: 2 is common for SD1.5; keep 1 for SDXL (>1 is experimental and warns in preflight).
cls_loss_weight: Weight of the in-domain binary classification loss. Recommended: near 1.
cls_pos_weight: Positive-class weight for classification. Leave empty for no extra weighting.
color_aug: Random color jitter augmentation. Incompatible with disk latent caching; avoid for palette-critical styles.
compile_anima_full_core_enabled: Compiles the whole Anima DiT into a single graph: long compile, big payoff for long runs only.
compile_cache_enabled: Reuses compiled graphs across runs to shorten restarts. Keep on (default).
compile_cache_reuse: Load existing on-disk compile caches. Keep true.
compile_cache_root: Root folder for compile caches; prefer a fast disk.
compile_contract_strict: Enforces routing safety gates before training. Keep true.
compile_inductor_tuning: Inductor fusion tuning level; max_autotune helps steady-state at heavy first-pass cost. Keep off.
compile_probe_enabled: Short probe validates compile gains before committing; falls back otherwise. Keep true.
compile_probe_max_vram_increase_ratio: Max VRAM growth allowed by the probe vs baseline. Recommended: keep 0.15.
compile_probe_min_speedup_ratio: Fall back if measured speedup is below this ratio. Recommended: keep 0.03.
compile_probe_steps: Steps sampled by the probe. Recommended: keep 3.
compile_require_cache_first: Static/full compilation requires prebuilt caches. Keep true.
compile_runtime: torch.compile runtime strategy; start off until gains are validated on your model.
compile_shape_strategy: Input-shape strategy for compilation. auto recommended.
compile_static_shape_drop_last: Drops ragged tail batches so shapes stay static. Keep true.
compile_target_strategy: What gets compiled; auto probes module capability. Keep auto.
compression_companion_auto_bootstrap: Fits a product-fp8 residual once to synthesize a missing companion path. Off by default; opt in deliberately.
compression_companion_bootstrap_max_laye: Cap on bootstrapped layers; 0 covers all intersecting Linears. Recommended: keep 0.
compression_companion_bootstrap_rank: Rank of the bootstrapped residual adapter. Recommended: keep 4.
compression_companion_enabled: Loads a frozen recovery adapter before compression to restore fidelity (baked or side-path); fails closed without one. Use when FP8 bases lose visible quality.
compression_companion_missing_policy: When no path exists: fail hard (safer default) or downgrade_t1 to keep compression with a warning. Keep fail.
compression_companion_mode: merge_into_base bakes it into the base; sidepath_frozen keeps it aside without consuming a train slot. Prefer merge_into_base.
compression_companion_scale: Scaling applied when merging or side-loading the companion. Recommended: keep 1.
compression_companion_type: Adapter kind of the recovery companion. lora default.
concept_edit_base_model: Reference base model for concept editing; same lineage as the training base preferred.
concept_edit_data_dir: Dataset folder for concept editing; same layout as training datasets.
concept_edit_diff_alt_ratio: Ratio between difference and alternate samples. Recommended: probe 0.2-0.5.
concept_edit_fixed_timestep_per_batch: Fixes the timestep within a batch to cut variance. Experimental.
concept_edit_method: Concrete concept-edit algorithm selection. Default first.
concept_edit_use_diff_mask: Constrain edits via difference masks. Enable for localized changes only.
concept_geometry_alias_map_path: JSON alias map path for concept-geometry names.
concept_geometry_density_power: Exponent applied to geometric density when sampling. Recommended: keep 1.
concept_geometry_embedding_allow_downloa: Allow network downloads of embedding models. Keep off offline; default false.
concept_geometry_embedding_api_base: Endpoint used when the embedding provider is api.
concept_geometry_embedding_api_key: Credential for the embedding API. Prefer an environment variable or a local model over storing keys in a saved config.
concept_geometry_embedding_api_model: Model name requested from the remote embedding API.
concept_geometry_embedding_backend: Inference backend for embeddings: pytorch or the onnx extension point. Keep pytorch.
concept_geometry_embedding_batch_size: Batch size for embedding prep. Recommended: keep 8.
concept_geometry_embedding_device: Device for embedding compute; cpu default suffices for small encoders.
concept_geometry_embedding_model: Text-embedding model id used to enrich concept geometry, for example BAAI/bge-m3. Applies when the provider downloads or resolves by id.
concept_geometry_embedding_model_path: Local directory of the embedding model; used when the embedding provider is local_path.
concept_geometry_embedding_provider: Where text-embedding models come from: local path (most controllable), auto-download, or API.
concept_geometry_enabled: Concept Geometry samples/weights by concept geometry to control inter-concept distances. Try when concepts bleed together.
concept_geometry_loss_weighting: Derives per-sample loss weights from geometric density. Experimental.
concept_geometry_sampler_mode: Sampling mode blending curriculum and density drives. Keep the default blend.
concept_geometry_semantic_enabled: Enriches geometry with text embeddings during prep. Good with rich captions.
concept_geometry_source_priority: Comma-separated order in which concept names are resolved (explicit, folder, nl, identity, tag, stem); the first source that yields a name wins. Keep the default unless your dataset labels concepts unusually.
concept_geometry_translation_api_base: Endpoint used when the translation provider is api.
concept_geometry_translation_api_key: Credential for the translation API. Prefer an environment variable or a local model over storing keys in a saved config.
concept_geometry_translation_api_model: Model name requested from the remote translation API.
concept_geometry_translation_batch_size: Batch size for translation prep. Recommended: keep 8.
concept_geometry_translation_enabled: Optional translation pass unifying caption language during prep. Only for mixed-language sets.
concept_geometry_translation_model_path: Local directory of the translation model; used when the translation provider is local_path.
concept_geometry_translation_provider: Translation provider: local path or API. Prefer local_path.
conditioning_data_dir: Conditioning image dataset path; when empty the backend falls back to sibling *_control files discovered automatically.
contrastive_flow_matching: Enable CFM. When Enable Rectified Flow
contrastive_latent_enabled: Contrastive consistency pulling representations of shared clean latents together across noise pairs. Experimental.
contrastive_latent_max_t: Upper bound of the mid-noise window. Recommended: keep 0.8.
contrastive_latent_min_t: Lower bound confining pairs to mid noise (e.g. 0.2). Recommended: keep 0.2.
contrastive_latent_noise_pairs: Noise pairs constructed per sample. Recommended: range 1-5.
contrastive_latent_temperature: Temperature coefficient (reserved; unused by current impl). Recommended: keep default.
conv_alpha: Alpha scaling for Conv layers. Recommended: match conv_dim (=dim or dim/2).
conv_dim: Rank for Conv layers. Recommended: equal to network_dim or half; applies only to Conv targets.
cooldown_every_n_epochs: Insert a cooldown every N epochs so the GPU breathes. Recommended: 2-5 with a temperature target.
cooldown_minutes: Minimum minutes per cooldown pause. Recommended: try 5-15 depending on cooling.
cooldown_poll_seconds: Temperature poll interval during cooldowns. Recommended: keep 15.
cooldown_until_temp_c: Resume only below this temperature. Recommended: aim 60-70 C for longevity.
coreset_auto_classify_after: Re-grading interval in steps. Recommended: keep 50.
coreset_classify_after: Steps before grading begins. Recommended: around 500.
coreset_easy_threshold: Loss threshold marking a sample easy. Recommended: around 0.1.
coreset_easy_weight: Sampling weight for easy samples. Recommended: keep 1.
coreset_enabled: Coreset grades samples easy/hard/toxic from loss history for importance sampling. Helps uneven-quality datasets.
coreset_hard_loss_threshold: Loss multiple marking hard samples. Recommended: keep 1.5.
coreset_hard_weight: Weight for hard samples. Recommended: 1-2 emphasizes them.
coreset_report_enabled: Writes the grading report for auditing bad samples. Keep on.
coreset_report_every_n_epochs: Report cadence in epochs. Recommended: keep 1.
coreset_report_top_k: Rows listed per report. Recommended: keep 20.
coreset_toxic_std_threshold: Std-dev multiple flagging toxic outliers. Recommended: keep 3.
coreset_toxic_weight: Toxic-sample weight; 0 skips them entirely. Recommended: keep 0.
cpu_offload_checkpointing: Offloads checkpoint tensors to CPU for extra savings at a larger speed cost. Extreme-VRAM cases only.
cpu_offload_checkpointing_mode: How checkpointing combines with CPU offload: auto decides, full offloads everything. Start none; switch to auto under OOM.
cpu_offload_checkpointing_pool_gb: CPU-side pinned pool for checkpoints in GB. Recommended: 4-16 within a quarter of physical RAM.
cross_attn_fused_kv: Fused K/V projection kernels for SDXL cross-attention. Enable after validating stability.
cuda_cache_release_interval: Minimum steps between cache releases. Recommended: 1; raise to reduce jitter.
cuda_cache_release_strategy: Cache-release policy: oom_only releases after OOM recovery (recommended); aggressive hurts throughput.
data_backend: Data backend selection; auto/caption currently share the CaptionDataset implementation. Keep auto.
data_transfer_profile_enabled: Profiles CPU/GPU tensor transfer timings. For performance analysis.
data_transfer_profile_mode: Timing mode using CUDA events with minimal sync cost. Keep event.
data_transfer_profile_window: Transfers aggregated per summary line. Recommended: keep 50.
dataloader_num_workers: DataLoader worker processes feeding the GPU. Recommended: 2-8; very high values slow startup on Windows.
dataset_intelligence_concept_rarity_stre: Balances sampling by concept rarity against dominance by frequent concepts. Recommended: probe 0.5-2; 0 off.
dataset_intelligence_curriculum_easy_end: Curriculum: prefer easy samples until this progress fraction. Recommended: ~0.33.
dataset_intelligence_curriculum_normal_e: After this fraction hard samples phase in; must exceed the easy-phase end. Recommended: ~0.66.
dataset_intelligence_enabled: Offline analysis builds a Manifest of quality/caption/difficulty/coverage/rarity; training reads only the Manifest. Run it before serious training.
dataset_intelligence_max_weight: Ceiling on sample weights preventing hard-sample domination. Recommended: 4.
dataset_intelligence_min_weight: Floor on sample weights preventing over-suppression. Recommended: 0.25.
dataset_intelligence_region_balance_stre: Balances sampling by region coverage so backgrounds do not dominate. Recommended: probe 0.5-2; 0 off.
dataset_intelligence_sampling_mode: Manifest-driven sampling strategy (fixed order vs curriculum). Start fixed; switch to curriculum after vetting the Manifest.
dataset_intelligence_seed: Seed for the sampling plan so identical inputs reproduce identical schedules. Recommended: fix it.
dataset_intelligence_target_caption_lang: Target language for Manifest captions; auto follows the data. Pin it only when evaluating in one language.
dct_frequency_enabled: DCT frequency-domain loss boosts high-frequency penalties against meshing/noise. Try when textures shimmer.
dct_frequency_high_weight: High-vs-low frequency weight multiplier. Recommended: keep 2.0.
dct_frequency_low_cutoff: Fraction treated as low-frequency cutoff. Recommended: keep 0.3.
dct_frequency_max_t: Upper sigma bound (1 = full range). Recommended: keep 1.
dct_frequency_min_t: Lower sigma bound (0 = full range). Recommended: keep 0.
dct_frequency_weight: DCT loss weight relative to main loss. Recommended: 0.05-0.15.
ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view: DDP gradient-as-bucket-view saves memory/time. Keep on (backend default true).
ddp_static_graph: Declares a static graph for faster DDP. Only for runs with no conditional graph branches.
ddp_timeout: DDP collective timeout seconds; 0 uses backend default. Recommended: raise above 1800 for slow storage/startups.
decompose_both: Additionally decompose the smaller LoKr side matrix to save parameters at speed cost. Keep off unless parameter-bound.
deep_diagnostics_enabled: Deep diagnostics add verbose probes; enable only while chasing hard bugs.
delta_lora_enabled: Delta-LoRA folds the BA delta into the frozen base each step. Keep off by default; try on long validated runs.
detected_vram_gb: Detected VRAM capacity in GiB, written by the UI so profile recommendations can reason about the host; not user-facing.
dim_from_weights: Infer rank/dim from loaded network_weights instead of manual values. Useful when resuming unknown checkpoints.
disable_mmap_load_safetensors: Disable mmap loading of safetensors in favor of plain reads. Use when mmap conflicts with low-RAM mode.
discrete_flow_shift: Discrete-flow sampling shift; higher favors high-noise segments. Recommended: commonly 3-4; defer to your model family default.
distillation_diversity_anchor_weight: Recommended: anti-collapse diversity anchor weight; start 0, add ~0.01 if modes collapse.
distillation_enabled: Distills a few-step student from a many-step teacher (DP-DMD/AnyFlow): much slower and heavier — not an accelerator. Only for few-step artifacts.
distillation_fake_critic_margin: Margin for the fake critic term. Recommended: keep 0.05.
distillation_fake_critic_weight: Recommended: adversarial fake-critic weight; 0 keeps training stable.
distillation_guidance_scale: CFG used when baking teacher targets (non-acceleration). DP-DMD treats non-1 as bake-on. Recommended: keep 1.
distillation_loss_weight: Overall weight of distillation alignment loss. Recommended: 1; higher drowns the student objective.
distillation_mode: dp_dmd_turbo is the main few-step path; anyflow is flow-matching consistency distillation. Prefer dp_dmd_turbo.
distillation_objective: Objective label paired with mode; keep them consistent. Leave as-is.
distillation_prediction_type: Prediction target both sides align on; match your base model (velocity common).
distillation_softrank_every_n: Compute SoftRank every N steps. Recommended: keep 1.
distillation_softrank_k: Top-k size for SoftRank. Recommended: keep 4.
distillation_softrank_pool_size: Sampling pool size for SoftRank. Recommended: keep 128.
distillation_softrank_softness: Softness coefficient for ranking. Recommended: keep 0.25.
distillation_softrank_warmup_ratio: Skip SoftRank for this initial fraction of steps. Recommended: keep 0.
distillation_softrank_weight: Recommended: softRank regularization weight; start at 0.
distillation_student_steps: Student ODE steps (commonly 1-8). Fewer steps are harder to align. Recommended: start at 4.
dit_compute_reducer_min_block: Leading blocks exempt from skipping. Recommended: keep 1.
dit_compute_reducer_skip_every: Skip one of every N candidate blocks (0 off). Recommended: ratio control preferred.
dit_compute_reducer_skip_ratio: Ratio driving skip frequency. Recommended: stay conservative <=0.25.
dit_compute_reducer_strategy: Planned skipping of DiT blocks for speed experiments. Start none, A/B first.
dit_low_vram_profile: DiT low-VRAM profiles mapping onto existing residency/offload combos (not a third system). Start off; pick a level when needed.
dokr_alpha: DoKr Kronecker scaling numerator. Recommended: keep 1.0.
dokr_decompose_factor: Low-rank split for w2; 0 keeps w2 intact. Recommended: keep 0.
dokr_enabled: DoKr combines LoKr Kronecker directions with DoRA magnitude. Try when LoKr feels weak at its parameter count.
dokr_factor_in: DoKr input-side factor preference; 0 defaults to 8. Recommended: keep 0.
dokr_factor_out: DoKr output-side factor preference; 0 defaults to 8. Recommended: keep 0.
dokr_mode: DoKR gating: full trains both; style magnitude-only; structure direction-only. Start with full.
dop_detach_reference: Detaches the reference side so gradients never reach the base. Safety toggle, keep true.
dop_enabled: DOP anchors outputs near the base model to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Enable when concepts wash out.
dop_interval: Apply DOP every N steps. Recommended: keep 1.
dop_start_step: First step where DOP applies. Recommended: keep 0.
dop_target: Where DOP acts: final output or intermediate features. Keep output.
dop_weight: DOP regularization weight. Recommended: 0.1; higher strangles new concepts.
dora_enabled: DoRA decomposes weights into direction+magnitude for higher expressivity than plain LoRA at a small speed cost. Stack on native LoRA only; mutually exclusive with LyCORIS families.
dora_mode: DoRA gating: full trains both factors, style magnitude-only, structure direction-only. full recommended.
dora_normalize_magnitude: Normalize DoRA magnitude vectors during updates.
dora_use_scalar_magnitude: Use scalar magnitude instead of per-channel magnitude (cheaper).
dora_variant: classic standard DoRA vs lulynx stop-gradient engineering variant with identical forward values. Keep classic.
dora_wd: Alias switch normalized by the backend to use_dora/dora_enabled=true with bypass_mode forced off; mutually exclusive with LyCORIS families. Enable for stronger concept binding.
down_lr_weight: Per-layer LR weights for the encoder section, 0-1; below threshold counts as zeroed.
dp_dmd_variant: DP-DMD variant: lulynx_optimized regression path vs standard requiring a dual score provider (fails fast if absent). Prefer lulynx_optimized.
dpo_anchor_alpha: MSE anchor keeping policy near ref; 0 disables. Recommended: start 0.
dpo_enabled: DPO/Flow-DPO preference alignment needs dpo_weight > 0 to engage; real rejected-latent pairs use four-way margins, otherwise a weak perturbation proxy applies. Prepare data first.
dpo_logprob_scale: Variance scale of the weak-proxy density. Recommended: keep 1.
dpo_pair_mode: auto= rejected_latents Flow-DPO; flow= Force pair (skip); proxy= Force.
dpo_preference_pair_field: : batch rejected velocity target; Empty =. And pair latent.
dpo_rejected_latent_cache_dir: By stem lose clean latent ; Empty = From . And preferred spatial.
dpo_rejected_latent_required: Errors out when rejected files are missing instead of silently skipping. Enable for strict pipelines.
dpo_rejected_perturb: Perturbation strength synthesizing rejected targets. Recommended: keep 0.1.
dpo_weight: Master DPO weight (must exceed 0). Recommended: start 0.1-0.5.
dropout: Main LyCORIS dropout probability. Recommended: 0-0.1, default 0.
dry_run: On by default: validates dataset/config contracts and writes a metadata stub without launching real training. Turn off for the actual run.
dtype: Base-model load/compute dtype. auto picks per device. Prefer auto or bf16; fp16 only where bf16 is unsupported.
dual_caption_enabled: Read short+long caption channels from structured annotations. Enable when both are high quality.
dynamo_backend: Dynamo backend written to torch_compile_backend; inductor is the workhorse.
easy_control_channels: Input channels of legacy EasyControl conditioning (3 = RGB). Recommended: match your condition images.
easy_control_enabled: Legacy EasyControl entry point. Prefer the v2 controls; keep this off on new runs.
easy_control_scale: Legacy control strength; higher obeys the control image more. Recommended: 0.5-1.
easycontrol_v2_cond_channels: Last-dim size of condition latents/tokens; must match cache layout. Recommended: keep 16.
easycontrol_v2_cond_lora_rank: LoRA rank of the condition branch. Recommended: ~8.
easycontrol_v2_cond_noise_max: Max noise on condition latents; 0 keeps them clean. Recommended: keep 0.
easycontrol_v2_control_image_dir: Root directory holding the control images.
easycontrol_v2_control_kind: Kind of control stream (reference_latent default). Keep unless your pipeline differs.
easycontrol_v2_control_suffix: Filename suffix that pairs a control image with its training image.
easycontrol_v2_drop_p: Probability of dropping the whole condition per sample (CFG robustness). Recommended: keep 0.1.
easycontrol_v2_enabled: EasyControl v2 dual-stream conditioning on the Anima faithful route. Enable for control-image goals.
easycontrol_v2_match_target_bucket: Aligns condition images to training buckets. Enable for ragged condition aspect ratios.
easycontrol_v2_scale: Scale of injected condition streams. Recommended: keep 1.
easycontrol_v2_text_cache_dir: Text-encoder output cache directory for EasyControl v2.
ed_lora_enabled: ED-LoRA splits text embeddings into random+class components for tighter text alignment. Suits text-driven concepts.
ed_lora_fusion_lr: Fusion optimizer learning rate. Recommended: keep default 1e-3.
ed_lora_fusion_rank: Rank of the fused artifact. Recommended: ~4.
ed_lora_fusion_steps: Gradient steps per fusion merge. Recommended: ~30.
ed_lora_num_concepts: Concept components count. Recommended: keep 1 for now.
ed_lora_num_layers: Text-encoder layers involved in decomposition. Recommended: 6-24 (default 12).
ed_lora_sequence_length: Token sequence length; CLIP standard is 77. Recommended: keep unless your model differs.
edit_mask_field: Optional metadata field holding the edited-region mask. Leave the default unless your dataset uses another field name.
edit_mask_policy: Whether masks are required; optional tolerates samples without one. Not user-facing.
edit_mask_weight: Loss multiplier applied inside edit_mask when one is present. Recommended: keep 1.0 for neutral weighting and raise gently to push the edited region.
edit_preserve_mask_field: Optional metadata field holding the preserve-region mask. Leave the default unless your dataset uses another field name.
edit_preserve_weight: Extra constraint on the preserve_mask region when one is present. Recommended: keep 0 unless the untouched area drifts.
edit_source_path_policy: How source-image paths are resolved; auto lets the backend infer them from the dataset. Not user-facing.
edit_source_prompt_field: Optional metadata field holding the source-image prompt. Leave the default unless your dataset uses another field name.
edit_target_path_policy: How target-image paths are resolved; auto lets the backend infer them from the dataset. Not user-facing.
edit_target_prompt_field: Optional metadata field holding the target-image prompt. Leave the default unless your dataset uses another field name.
edit_timestep_schedule: Controls how strongly the reference latent is injected across noise stages: early_lock anchors composition early, mid_edit shifts influence to mid noise, mask_preserve favors the preserved region, off disables the schedule. Keep early_lock.
edit_training_enabled: Marks the run as edit training; fixed per type and not user-facing.
edit_training_mode: Edit training mode (edit_lora and friends); fixed per type and not user-facing.
ema_decay: EMA decay; closer to 1 smooths more and reacts slower. Recommended: 0.998-0.9995.
ema_enabled: Maintains an EMA shadow of parameters for smoother checkpoints (one extra parameter copy). Worth comparing on longer runs.
ema_update_after_step: First optimizer step where EMA updates begin. Recommended: 0 or a few hundred warmup steps both work.
ema_update_every: EMA update cadence in optimizer steps. Recommended: keep 1.
enable_base_weight: Base-weight mixing experiment (difference blending). Novelty feature; keep off normally.
enable_block_weights: Assign per-section LR weights across encoder/mid/decoder via down/mid/up tables. Works with networks.* only; use to fix section-level fit issues.
enable_bucket: Aspect-ratio bucketing groups images by ratio to reduce cropping. Fully supported on UNet routes; on DiT cache-first families it mainly affects online/rebuild paths. Keep on (default).
enable_distributed_training: Enable DDP multi-GPU training. Skip when a single GPU fits; note batch is per-GPU once on.
enable_inference_accel: Speeds preview sampling via Spectrum/SmoothCache compute skipping at slight quality cost. Enable for long runs.
enable_mixed_resolution_training: Staged-resolution training (SDXL only): warm up low-res, finish high-res. Good for longer quality runs.
enable_preview: Generates preview images during training to watch convergence. Enable with 1-2 images per round; disable at extreme VRAM.
enable_sequential_cpu_offload: Layer-by-layer sequential CPU offload with on-demand load: minimal VRAM, big slowdown. Last-resort option.
enhanced_protection_mode: When On Allow Auto PCIe Format To FP8.
ephemeral_preview_pipeline: Destroys the preview pipeline after each render so VAE memory returns. Keep on in tight-VRAM setups (default).
epochs: Training epochs (distillation/smoke flow). Recommended: start with 1-10 epochs matched to dataset size.
eval_batch_size: Eval batch size; 0/empty reuses the training batch. Recommended: match or halve it to avoid eval OOM.
eval_data_dir: Standalone validation directory. When filled, no validation split is carved out of the training set.
execution_backend: Execution backend: optimized runs without graph compilation; thunder is the recommended compiled path; torch_compile alternative. Prefer optimized or thunder.
execution_backend_allow_fallback: Fall back to the optimized runtime when Thunder/torch.compile is unsafe or unavailable. Keep true.
experimental_attention_profile_torch_max: Sequence cap for the plain-PyTorch O(n^2) fallback against VRAM blowups. Recommended: keep 2048.
experimental_attention_profile_window: Sliding-window attention span in tokens (0 = full attention). Recommended: probe from 50-100.
export_comfy_int8_base: dense Quantization As Comfy INT8 (, Is LoRA). Enable Merge Or full_finetune
export_comfy_int8_engine: Comfy INT8 engine: convrot real rotation (better fidelity) vs rowwise no-rotation (faster). Prefer convrot.
export_comfy_int8_groupsize: ConvRot group size, power of four. Recommended: keep 256.
fera_enabled: FERA feature-probe branch. Experimental observation only.
fera_gate_init: Initial FERA gate value. Recommended: keep 0.
fg_lora_rank_conserve_budget: Keeps total rank within the uniform-allocation budget during orthogonal reallocation. Keep true.
fg_lora_rank_map_json: FIM Scan Layer rank (JSON: { Full Layer Path:
fg_lora_rank_max: Maximum rank per layer that high-score layers approach. Recommended: keep ~32.
fg_lora_rank_min: Minimum rank assigned per layer. Recommended: keep 4.
fg_lora_rank_policy: How ranks distribute across layers. Start uniform.
fg_lora_rank_profile: Depth profile shape of rank allocation; center_peak matches typical U-Net importance.
fid_real_image_dir: Real-reference folder for FID; use an independent set matching the training distribution.
fim_scan_calib_steps: Calibration backward steps for the scan. Recommended: keep 8.
fim_scan_enabled: FIM scan estimates per-layer sensitivity to guide rank allocation. Run before redesigning ranks.
fim_scan_r_max: Upper bound of suggested ranks. Recommended: keep 64.
fim_scan_r_min: Lower bound of suggested ranks. Recommended: keep 8.
fim_scan_suggest_ratio: Fraction of layers flagged as suggested. Recommended: keep 0.5.
fim_scan_tool: Training Before Fisher Scan Layer, Auto " Layer +
flashattn: Force FlashAttention 2 as an override. Off by default; strong long-sequence speedups when installed.
flexrank_lora_enabled: FlexRank samples the active rank each step, acting as regularization. Try when overfitting.
flexrank_lora_rank_range_min: Lower bound of sampled active rank (upper bound = network_dim). Recommended: 25-50% of dim.
flip_aug: Random horizontal flip doubles viewpoints. Great for symmetric subjects; off for text/direction-sensitive content.
flow_logit_mean: Mean of logit-normal sampling; negative shifts toward detail bands. Recommended: keep 0 centered.
flow_logit_std: Std of logit-normal sampling (>0); smaller concentrates the band. Recommended: keep 1.
flow_model: Switches to Rectified Flow objectives; pair with flow-based bases only, never classic UNet checkpoints.
flow_timestep_distribution: RF timestep distribution; logit_normal is the sane default.
flow_uncertainty_weighting_enabled: EDM2-style learnable per-sigma uncertainty weighting u(sigma). Experimental but principled.
flow_uniform_base_pixels: Recommended: reference pixel count for resolution-aware shifting (1024^2 = 1048576); match your main area.
flow_uniform_shift: Shifts RF timesteps dynamically by pixel count; useful for mixed-resolution sets.
flow_uniform_static_ratio: Static shift ratio overriding dynamic logic; empty disables. Recommended: prefer dynamic.
flow_use_ot: Re-pairs latents by cosine OT coupling. Try on small-batch slow convergence.
flux2_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many FLUX.2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
flux2_block_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum FLUX.2 block size (MiB) eligible for offload.
flux2_block_offload_pin_memory: Pin host memory for FLUX.2 block offload transfers.
flux2_block_offload_ratio: Share of FLUX.2 blocks eligible for offload. Recommended: 100 to stream as much as possible, or 0 to disable; partial values rarely pay off.
flux2_block_residency: Residency policy for FLUX.2 transformer blocks: resident keeps them all on GPU, block_offload streams them adaptively. Keep block_offload unless VRAM is plentiful.
flux2_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleaves copies of FLUX.2 single-stream blocks (parallel blocks, with the fused attention/MLP output projection zeroed) so the inserted layers start as identity residuals; the run saves a complete new base model.
flux2_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total single-stream transformer blocks after expansion; the 8 dual-stream blocks are untouched. Recommended: above the native 48 of Klein-9B, for example 60.
flux2_depth_expansion_train_scope: Trains the inserted layers only, the inserted layers plus the input/time/output periphery, or every parameter. new_layers is the conservative default.
flux2_model_version: Flux2 version tag controlling structure branches and caches; must match the checkpoint.
flux_transformer_offload: Flux transformer offload level: off fastest, auto picks per VRAM, aggressive streams (slowest). Keep auto.
forgetting_probe_enabled: Monitors concept-forgetting signals during training and reports them. Useful on long multi-concept runs.
forgetting_probe_interval: Probe cadence in optimizer steps. Recommended: keep 50.
forgetting_probe_num_anchors: Anchor samples used for comparison. Recommended: keep 4.
fp8_base: Loads the frozen base in FP8 to halve base-model VRAM (legacy entry; prefer the weight-compression preset). Recommended for large-rank SDXL or Anima on 24 GB.
fp8_base_unet: FP8 for U-Net/DiT only, keeping TE high precision. Prefer over full-FP8 when text binding matters.
fractional_grad_damping_enabled: Fractional-order damping smooths gradients over history. Experimental; off by default.
fractional_grad_damping_order: Order alpha in (0,1]; smaller smooths more. Recommended: keep 0.5.
freeze_extractors: Freezes the JTP-3/Waifu CLIP extractors to stop auxiliary drift. Keep true (default).
full_bf16: Full BF16 training including master weights; more stable than fp16 with slight precision cost. Enable on RTX30+ only when VRAM is tight.
full_fp16: Full FP16 training including master weights; saves VRAM but risks NaN overflow. Keep off except on old GPUs that truly need it.
full_matrix: Force LoKr onto the full-matrix path, trading savings for stability. Use temporarily when debugging numerics.
fused_backward_grad_clip_mode: LOMO/AdaLOMO clip mode: default skips clipping (fastest); full adds a pre-pass for exact global norm; per_param approximates. Keep default.
fused_projection_memory_mode: Memory handling for fused projection weights; keep_original is most compatible.
gdlokr_factor: Shared GDLoKr Kronecker factor; 0 auto-balances. Recommended: keep 0.
gdlokr_mode: GDLoKr generalized-direction mode. Keep full to mirror DoKr.
gemma2_max_token_length: Max token length for Gemma2 text encoder paths.
gemma3_prompt: Gemma3 system prompt. Aligned with the official template by default.
gloo_socket_ifname: Network interface name for Gloo (multi-node Ethernet).
goal_forecast_tool: Training run loss / Validation loss / L2 When
gpu_circuit_device_index: GPU index polled for circuit-breaker monitoring. Recommended: 0 on single-GPU.
gpu_circuit_enabled: By / VRAM /throttle/ECC STOP (checkpoint). NVML When Auto no-op.
gpu_circuit_poll_interval_steps: Health-poll cadence in steps. Recommended: keep 10.
gpu_circuit_temp_c: Hard trip temperature; 0 disables. Recommended: consider 85 on heat-troubled rigs.
gpu_circuit_temp_warn_c: Warning band below the hard threshold; 0 off. Recommended: set 5-10 C under the trip point.
gpu_circuit_trip_on_ecc: Trip immediately on ECC uncorrected increments. Keep on to protect data integrity.
gpu_circuit_trip_on_throttle: Trip on critical throttle events. Worth enabling in hot environments.
gpu_circuit_vram_util_pct: Trip at this VRAM utilization percent (0 off). Recommended: 98 guards against OOM cascades.
gpu_duty_cycle: Idle fraction inserted after each step for thermals (0.2 = 20% yield). Recommended: use 0.2-0.5 in hot environments.
gpu_ids: GPU indices taking part in the run, comma-separated (for example 0,1). Empty lets the launcher use every visible device.
gpu_lock_clocks_mhz: Locks core clock ceiling via nvidia-smi before training (admin needed). Recommended: cap at 80-90% baseline when overheating.
gpu_power_limit_w: Sets the power limit in watts before training. Recommended: 70-90% of rated buys thermal headroom.
gpu_target_temp_c: Closed-loop temperature target lowering duty cycle past it. Recommended: 70 C is a common pick.
gradient_accumulation_mode: Grad accumulation implementation: fast syncs/checks only at optimizer steps (faster); classic keeps legacy per-microbatch checks. Keep fast; switch to classic only when debugging accumulation issues.
gradient_accumulation_steps: Accumulate N micro-batches per update, scaling effective batch without extra peak VRAM. Recommended: 1 (default) or 4-8; effective batch = batch_size x this value.
gradient_checkpointing: Recomputes activations in backward to save VRAM at ~20-30% speed cost. Keep on (default) unless VRAM is plentiful.
gradient_guard_agc_clip_factor: AGC caps grad norm at this fraction of weight norm. Recommended: around default 0.01.
gradient_guard_agc_eps: Floor for weight norms in AGC to avoid division by zero. Recommended: keep default 1e-3.
gradient_guard_strategy: Gradient guard mode: none disables; agc clips per parameter-norm ratio; centralized variants add pooled norm guards. Keep none by default; try agc when training destabilizes.
gradient_release_enabled: Frees gradients per-parameter to cut peak grad memory (default on). Keep on; incompatible optimizers fall back safely.
gradient_release_grad_clip_mode: Clip mode: exact global norm (default, ~+183MB at gas=1), per_param approximate saving memory, report_only observes. Keep exact.
gradient_release_mode: Gradient-release mode; compatible is the only tier today. Keep compatible.
gram_texture_enabled: Gram-matrix texture loss counters mesh-like artifacts by matching texture statistics.
gram_texture_max_t: Upper sigma bound (1 = full range). Recommended: keep 1.
gram_texture_min_t: Lower sigma bound (0 = full range). Recommended: keep 0.
gram_texture_normalize: Normalizes Gram by C*H*W so scale cancels. Keep true.
guidance_scale: Recommended: cFG/guidance strength; start 1.0-2.0 for LCM-style models, otherwise follow your teacher setup.
h3_activation_offload_min_tensor_mb: Minimum tensor size (MB) considered for activation offload. Recommended: >=10.
h3_audio_loss_weight: Audio-branch loss weight relative to video. Recommended: keep 1 for balanced AV training.
h3_audio_sigma_shift: Sigma-mapping shift for audio. Recommended: keep 3.
h3_audio_vae_path: Audio VAE weights required for joint audio-video tasks.
h3_block_swap_strategy: Swap scheduling: async hides transfer latency (recommended); sync is simpler.
h3_blocks_to_swap: Transformer blocks kept on CPU (0-48). Recommended: start 16 on 16 GB; less or none on 24 GB.
h3_cache_build_enabled: Skip cache building when off (requires existing cache). Keep on for first runs.
h3_cache_dir: Cache directory; empty uses the dataset default location.
h3_cache_include_audio: Also encode the audio VAE branch during cache build. Enable for audio tasks.
h3_cache_latents: Caches video/audio latents to avoid re-encoding each step. Keep true (default).
h3_cache_max_pixels: Pixel cap per sample entering the cache. Recommended: 262144 (~512x512).
h3_cache_max_samples: Cap on cached sample count; 0 unlimited. Recommended: small values help debugging loops.
h3_cache_rebuild: Ignore existing cache artifacts and rebuild. Run once after data changes.
h3_cache_text_encoder_outputs: Caches Qwen3-VL outputs to save TE memory and time. Keep true with fixed captions.
h3_cfg_preservation_enabled: Guidance-consistent SFT: preserve CFG behavior during training (no adapter loaded or merged).
h3_cfg_preservation_sigma_min: Skip CFG preservation below this base sigma (0 = everywhere). Recommended: keep 0.
h3_cfg_scale: Faithfulness CFG strength (distilled models prefer low CFG). Recommended: probe upward from 4 within 1-16.
h3_cfg_schedule: CFG schedule: constant, or decaying over low sigma. Start constant.
h3_checkpoint_mode: Activation checkpoint style: unsloth optimized recompute (recommended) vs standard.
h3_condition_noise_clean: Noising cleanliness of condition frames; closer to 1 keeps them cleaner. Recommended: keep 0.999.
h3_depth_expansion_enabled: Expands transformer depth by interleaved copying with identity init; full-finetune feature.
h3_depth_expansion_target_layers: Target depth after expansion; must exceed the base count. Recommended: set by capacity needs.
h3_depth_expansion_train_scope: Post-expansion training scope; new_layers mirrors classic depth up-scaling. Keep new_layers.
h3_fps: Frame rate feeding RoPE temporal encoding. Recommended: match your footage; recommended ~24.
h3_frame_count: Frames per training clip. Recommended: near default 39; longer clips cost more VRAM.
h3_image_timestep_shift: Timestep shift for single-image samples. Recommended: keep 1.
h3_int8_gemm_mode: INT8 GEMM selection: oracle picks per-layer by measurement (recommended) vs fixed policy.
h3_load_direct_to_device: Loads transformer tensors straight onto device avoiding a host mirror when swapping is off. Good for RAM-limited machines.
h3_partition: Model partition plan; fl2va_pruned trims branches irrelevant to the task (recommended).
h3_preserve_lora_master_dtype: Keeps LoRA master weights in FP32 against low-bit rounding drift (recommended true).
h3_prune_adaln_on_load: Prunes AdaLN via rank-8 SVD when loading full BF16 checkpoints (no-op on pruned models).
h3_te_layer_streaming: Streams Qwen3-VL decode layer-by-layer from CPU during cache building: lean but slower. Use on tight VRAM.
h3_text_encoder_path: Path to the Qwen3-VL text encoder weights used for conditioning and caching.
h3_timestep_shift: Timestep shift mapping biasing the noise schedule for video. Recommended: tune near default 12.
h3_transformer_path: Path to the H3 transformer (DiT backbone) weights. Required for training.
h3_unconditional_prompt: Unconditional branch prompt for CFG preservation (empty = backend default).
h3_video_only: Drops the audio branch keeping video latents only; saves VRAM for pure video tasks.
h3_video_sigma_shift: Sigma-mapping shift for video; coordinate with timestep shift. Recommended: default 12.
h3_video_vae_path: Video VAE weights converting pixels to latents for the video branch.
hard_negative_mining_enabled: Backprops only the top-k% highest-loss samples to focus on hard cases. Use when easy samples dilute learning.
hard_negative_mining_mode: Mining mode: top-k fraction or threshold-based. topk simpler.
hard_negative_mining_ratio: Fraction of hardest samples kept. Recommended: 0.5.
hard_negative_mining_threshold_multiplie: Threshold multiplier over mean loss in threshold mode. Recommended: keep 1.2.
hard_negative_mining_warmup_steps: Warm-up steps before mining kicks in. Recommended: keep 100.
hf_token_env: Name of the environment variable holding the HuggingFace token; the token itself is never stored in the config.
huber_auto_percentile: Quantile used to estimate delta in auto schedule. Recommended: near default 0.9.
huber_c: Huber transition threshold: quadratic below c, linear above. Recommended: near default 0.1.
huber_scale: Overall Huber loss scale. Recommended: keep 1; adjust dedicated weight axes instead.
huber_schedule: Huber threshold schedule: constant fixed; auto adapts from batch quantiles. Start constant; use auto when loss scale drifts.
hydralora_balance_loss_weight: Load-balancing loss weight against routing collapse. Recommended: 0.01-0.1; 0 disables.
hydralora_enabled: HydraLoRA shares A across multiple expert B branches with routing; suits multi-concept mixes at some extra VRAM.
hydralora_num_experts: Number of HydraLoRA expert branches. Recommended: 2-4.
hydralora_sparse_top_k: Compute only selected experts to save FLOPs. Enable when top_k < expert count.
hydralora_top_k: Experts activated per sample. Recommended: 2 or fewer.
image_decode_backend: Image decoder: pil safest; pil_lru caches decoded RGB keyed by mtime/size. pil_lru shines on big local sets.
image_decode_cache_size: Per-worker decoded-image LRU entries; 0 disables. Recommended: 64-256 by free RAM.
image_root: Directory. Empty When By Annotation File Path
immiscible_assignment_mode: Assignment algorithm: standard Hungarian (optimal, slower); lulynx_greedy row-greedy. Start with greedy.
immiscible_diffusion_enabled: Re-pairs noise/data within a minibatch by metric to reduce interference. Try on slow-converging small sets; off by default.
immiscible_metric: Pairing metric: l2 classic; cosine closer to flow OT. Keep defaults unless A/B testing.
include_waifu_score: Adds the Waifu Scorer v3 aesthetic branch; useful for aesthetics-driven goals, off otherwise.
initial_epoch: Starting epoch number for resumed runs (naming/log counter only, skips nothing). Recommended: keep 1 unless aligning with a resumed run.
initial_step: Starting step number for resumes (overrides initial_epoch). Recommended: pair with skip_until_initial_step to actually skip; keep 0 otherwise.
instance_prompt: Instance caption template for training images, usually containing the trigger word first and kept uniform across concepts.
ip_adapter_cond_dim: Condition width projected into the backbone (1152 for SigLIP); must match the encoder. Recommended: keep default.
ip_adapter_cond_mode: How conditions fuse into the stream; concat default.
ip_adapter_enabled: IP-Adapter injects reference-image conditioning for style/subject guidance.
ip_adapter_encoder_dim: Image-encoder output dimension tied to the chosen encoder. Recommended: leave unchanged.
ip_image_encoder_path: CLIP vision encoder path or HF id.
ip_noise_gamma: Injects perturbation into conditioning as regularization. Recommended: start at 0.1 cautiously; empty disables.
ip_noise_gamma_random_strength: Randomizes perturbation strength between 0 and gamma. Keep off for normal runs.
ip_num_tokens: Tokens injected into UNet by IP-Adapter. Recommended: 16 on SDXL.
jtp3_fallback_model_id: Fallback model id when JTP-3 load fails.
keep_tokens: Keeps the first N tags fixed during shuffling (usually trigger words). Recommended: set to your trigger count; 0 protects none.
keep_tokens_separator: Custom separator delimiting the protected prefix (e.g. |||). Leave empty to use commas.
krea2_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Krea-2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
krea2_block_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum Krea-2 block size (MiB) eligible for offload.
krea2_block_offload_pin_memory: Pin host memory for Krea-2 block offload transfers.
krea2_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Krea-2 block offload.
krea2_block_offload_ratio: Share of Krea-2 blocks eligible for offload, where 100 streams as many blocks as possible. Recommended: 100 or 0; partial values rarely pay off.
krea2_block_residency: Residency policy for Krea-2 blocks: resident keeps everything on GPU, block_offload streams whole blocks adaptively, layer_offload works at layer granularity for the tightest VRAM. Keep block_offload.
krea2_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave identity-initialized residual blocks while loading a Krea-2 full-finetune base.
krea2_depth_expansion_target_layers: Must exceed the source checkpoint depth. Use 40 to expand a 28-layer Krea-2 base.
krea2_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train inserted layers only, inserted layers plus input/output periphery, or the complete expanded model.
krea2_layer_offload_exclude_patterns: Comma-separated module name patterns excluded from Krea-2 layer offload.
krea2_layer_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum Krea-2 layer size (MiB) eligible for layer offload.
krea2_layer_offload_resident_ratio: Fraction of Krea-2 layers kept resident on GPU.
krea2_resident_block_count: Blocks pinned to GPU regardless of the offload policy. Recommended: keep 0 to let the policy decide, then raise a few blocks at a time if step time is transfer-bound.
krea2_sigma_selective_threshold: Selective threshold over sigma bands for Krea2 compute. Recommended: keep default.
krea2_text_fusion_mode: Controls cache format and DiT loading: fusion_frozen caches post-txtfusion output (default, tower frozen); fusion_trainable caches the raw 12-layer stack and loads the 343M txtfusion tower for training. Caches of the two modes are mutually incompatible.
krea2_training_mode: Krea2 training-mode selector; the default tier suits most tasks.
krea2_vram_preset: Krea2 VRAM preset tier; pick the tier matching actual VRAM, never above.
krona_allora: Module-level ALLoRA gradient normalization for KronA. Experimental.
krona_allora_eta: ALLoRA gradient scaling strength. Recommended: keep 2.
krona_enabled: KronA factorizes deltas via Kronecker products for fewer params than same-rank LoRA. Try under tight VRAM.
krona_factor_in: KronA input-side factor; 0 uses default 4. Recommended: keep 0.
krona_factor_out: KronA output-side factor; 0 uses default 64. Recommended: keep 0.
krona_weight_decompose: Add DoRA magnitude decomposition on KronA. Choose either this or the main DoRA toggle, not both.
latent_cache_disk_dtype: On-disk dtype for latents. fp16 halves size with negligible quality loss.
latent_cache_disk_format: Container format for disk latent cache. npz has the widest compatibility.
layer_monitor_enabled: Per-layer activation/gradient monitoring for locating misbehaving blocks.
layer_monitor_interval: Sampling cadence in optimizer steps. Recommended: keep 3.
layer_monitor_max_layers: Recommended: layers tracked per round; cap log volume around 10.
layer_monitor_mode: sampled is light; exact is exact but slow. Keep sampled.
layer_monitor_sample_size: Elements sampled per layer in sampled mode. Recommended: keep 4096.
layer_monitor_sparsity_epsilon: Threshold below which elements count as sparse. Recommended: keep 1e-8.
layer_precision_activation_geometry_path: Reads native safetensors containing aggregated E[x²] only.
layer_precision_default: Default format for ordinary quantizable layers. int8_convrot balances quality.
layer_precision_overrides_json: For exact overrides signed off via A/B testing only.
layer_precision_policy: Which sensitive layers keep higher precision (I/O, time-mod, norms). sensitive_bf16 recommended.
layer_precision_sensitivity_mode: Sensitivity estimator for layer choices. Start off; enable when tuning precision maps.
layered_alpha_enabled: Per-module-type alpha tables for fine capacity control; niche, off by default.
layersync_enabled: LayerSync self-aligns shallow layers to deeper ones without an external encoder, costing a bit of activation VRAM. Try when semantics drift.
layersync_every_n_steps: Compute every N steps to bound overhead (1 = each step). Recommended: 1-4 sensible.
layersync_student_block: Student block index; -1 auto-picks ~1/3 depth. Recommended: keep -1.
layersync_teacher_block: Teacher block index (must exceed student); -1 auto ~2/3 depth. Recommended: keep -1.
lcm_target_stride: Teacher consistency stride t -> t-stride. Recommended: ~80.
learning_rate: Base learning rate: the step size of each parameter update and the most important hyperparameter. Recommended: 1e-4 for LoRA (5e-5 for small datasets); 1e-6 to 5e-6 for full finetune; set 1.0 for Prodigy/DAdaptation self-tuning.
lineart_preservation_enabled: Line-art preservation via Sobel edge weighting inside latents. Great for illustration concepts.
lisa_enabled: LISA periodically activates only a subset of parameters, cutting optimizer memory on big adapters.
lisa_interval: Resampling cadence of active subsets. Recommended: keep 1.
lllite_cond_emb_dim: Condition embedding width for ControlNet-LLLite. Recommended: keep 32.
lllite_dropout: Dropout on the LLLite condition path. Recommended: 0-0.1, default 0.
lllite_mlp_dim: MLP bottleneck width of the LLLite adapter. Recommended: keep 64.
lllite_skip_input_blocks: Skip LLLite injection into input blocks to slim parameters.
lllite_skip_output_blocks: Output-block injection skipped by community convention. Keep true.
loftq_bits: LoftQ quantization bits (fake-quant init, not a persistent 4-bit base). Recommended: 4 or 8.
loftq_quant_type: Quant granularity: per-output-channel rowwise vs whole-tensor tensorwise. rowwise keeps better accuracy.
log_with: Metric reporting backend. tensorboard recommended; wandb needs network and an API key.
logging_dir: TensorBoard log directory. Keep default or a dedicated logs folder for run comparison.
lokr_factor: LoKr Kronecker factor: larger means fewer parameters and less expressivity; -1 = infinity (smallest). Recommended: 4 to start, up to 8; -1 for extreme compression.
glokr_factor: Shared GLoKr Kronecker factor: larger means fewer parameters and less expressivity; -1 auto-balances (recommended).
