lokr_no_materialize_forward: Compute LoKr forward from factors without materializing full weights: saves VRAM, may be slower. Worth trying when VRAM-bound on LoKr.
lokr_no_materialize_strategy: Implementation for non-materialized LoKr forward. auto heuristic recommended over legacy.
lokr_rank_dropout: LoKr per-rank dropout. Recommended: default 0; experiment within 0.1.
lokr_train_norm: Train norm layers alongside LoKr. Experimental; off by default.
lora2_adaptive_enabled: Learns per-module effective rank via exponentially-decayed weights. Try when picking ranks is hard.
lora2_adaptive_nu_init: Initial nu controlling decay speed. Recommended: keep 1.0.
lora2_adaptive_r_max: Recommended: maximum allowed rank; within ~2x network_dim.
lora2_gate_init: Initial nu of the LoRA2 rank gate (FP32 sigmoid, parity preserved at step 0). Recommended: keep 8.0 (backend default).
lora_activation_recompute_mode: Activation recompute level for native DiT LoRA backward; auto decides per setup.
lora_plus_enabled: LoRA+ trains the B matrix with a higher LR for faster upper adaptation. Pair with ratio 16; careful on small datasets.
lora_plus_lr_ratio: LR ratio of B vs A in LoRA+. Recommended: 16 (paper value); 1 disables.
lora_type: Primary adapter type; LoRA is the base route while DoRA/HydraLoRA variants live on their own toggles card. Keep lora.
loss: Regression loss choice. Keep mse; huber variants help with noisy data.
loss_precision: Precision policy for loss computation; fp32_loss is the stable path today. Keep it.
loss_scheduler_cooldown: Recommended: grace steps after progress before plateau checks resume; reduces oscillation.
loss_scheduler_ema_alpha: EMA smoothing of raw loss so single-batch noise cannot flip phases. Recommended: 0.05-0.2 (default 0.1).
loss_scheduler_late_gamma: Late-phase weighting exponent for annealed cosine. Recommended: keep 2.0.
loss_scheduler_lock_weight_threshold: Lock threshold for weighted-annealed cosine. Recommended: keep 0.7.
loss_scheduler_max_hold_steps: Recommended: cap on how long the phase may stay held; 0 unlimited or ~10% of total steps.
loss_scheduler_min_advance_ratio: Minimum phase-advance rate preventing stalls. Recommended: keep 0.25.
loss_scheduler_min_delta: Minimum EMA-loss drop counted as progress before the cosine advances. Recommended: keep near default 5e-4.
loss_scheduler_patience: Consecutive stalled steps tolerated before advancing the phase. Recommended: keep 8.
loss_scheduler_relative_delta: Progress judged relative to the best EMA loss. Recommended: keep default 0.001.
loss_state_enabled: Per-image loss state machine folded into difficulty weighting; great for hunting bad images.
loss_state_fusion_mode: How state verdicts fuse into weights; loss-led default.
loss_state_healthy_quantile: Quantile marking healthy residuals. Recommended: keep 0.4.
loss_state_lost_votes: Extra votes to declare stuck. Recommended: keep 2.
loss_state_lrugged_hits: High-residual share marking flat-lining. Recommended: keep 0.9.
loss_state_lrugged_votes: Confirmations before declaring degradation. Recommended: keep 3.
loss_state_num_bins: Timestep bins for state tracking. Recommended: keep 32.
loss_state_plateau_slope: Slope threshold marking saturation. Recommended: keep 0.001.
loss_state_watching_rise_epochs: Epochs of watch time before confirming. Recommended: keep 1.
loss_type: Loss function (l2/l1/huber...) controlling outlier sensitivity. Keep l2; try huber for noisy tags.
lossless_cache_replacement_decoded_paylo: Keeps decoded latents resident to cut repeat IO. Good with spare RAM and repeated passes.
Byte cap for the payload pool (0 unlimited). Recommended: set a cap to avoid OOM.
lossless_cache_replacement_fallback_to_r: Falls back to original npz when sidecars are missing/broken. Keep true.
lossless_cache_replacement_mode: Cache engine layout: off keeps per-file stores; sharded layout suits HDDs. Default off.
lossless_cache_replacement_read_mode: Read path: background-thread prefetch (default) vs mmap direct. Keep prefetch_thread.
lossless_cache_replacement_strict: CRC32/fingerprint checks rebuild corrupt caches automatically. Keep true.
low_vram_autotune_mode: Auto-tuning level for Triton under low VRAM. off keeps stock behavior; try auto when marginal.
low_vram_profile: Low-VRAM profile preset that bundles swap/offload/cache defaults.
lowram: Low-RAM mode loads weights straight onto GPU without a host mirror. For RAM-constrained machines, pair with disabling mmap.
lpips_latent_enabled: Latent-space perceptual similarity from DiT mid-features, LPIPS-style. For detail fidelity goals.
lpips_latent_normalize_features: L2-normalizes features so orientation matters over magnitude. Keep true.
lpips_latent_weight: LPIPS-latent weight relative to main loss. Recommended: 0.05-0.15.
lr_finder_enabled: LR Finder sweeps a learning-rate band before training to locate a good range. Run once on new bases/scales.
lr_finder_end_lr: Ending LR of the sweep; default reaches the diverging regime. Recommended: keep 0.1.
lr_finder_num_steps: Steps in the sweep; more is smoother but slower. Recommended: keep 100.
lr_finder_start_lr: Starting LR of the sweep. Recommended: keep 1e-7.
lr_scheduler: How LR evolves over training; affects mid/late convergence. For regular LoRA choose cosine or cosine_with_restarts; keep the default when unsure. Loss-gated schedulers suit experiments where an early cosine floor hurts.
lr_scheduler_args: Extra scheduler args (e.g. min_lr), one key=value per line. Unknown args are ignored; keep empty unless documented.
lr_scheduler_num_cycles: Restarts for cosine_with_restarts: LR rises again each cycle. Recommended: 1-4 (default 1).
lr_warmup_steps: Steps to linearly ramp LR up from 0, protecting early stability. Recommended: 0-500 steps (default 0; use ~100 for large datasets or high LR).
ltx23_block_offload_gpu_slots: Recommended: resident slots on GPU (2 suggested for 22B); shrink as VRAM tightens.
ltx23_block_offload_min_param_mb: Skip offloading blocks below this size (MB) to avoid tiny-transfer overhead. Recommended: 50.
ltx23_block_offload_pin_memory: Pinned host staging speeds H2D copies. Keep true with enough RAM.
ltx23_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Async prefetch depth for later blocks. Recommended: 1.
ltx23_block_offload_ratio: Share of blocks participating in offload (0-100%). Recommended: use 100 or 0; partial values rarely help.
ltx23_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleaves copied dual-stream blocks with identity-residual init (zeroed output projections), saving a complete new base.
ltx23_depth_expansion_target_layers: Recommended: total blocks after expansion (48 native on 22B-dev); must exceed the original count.
ltx23_depth_expansion_train_scope: Post-expansion scope: new layers only, plus periphery, or everything. Keep new_layers.
ltx23_fps: Recommended: fPS used by RoPE; match source footage (default 24, max 60).
ltx23_frame_stride: Source-frame gap between sampled frames; 1 is frame-exact, 2 doubles temporal coverage. Recommended: keep 1.
ltx23_isolate_modalities: Vision-only training disabling audio<->video crossings. Keep true for visual-only goals.
ltx23_max_text_length: Token cap for Gemma text caches shared by 2.3/2.5. Recommended: within default 256.
ltx23_target_frames: Recommended: target frames per training clip; 1 for images, else follow the 8n+1 pattern.
ltx23_text_encoder_path: Gemma3 text encoder matching the base; standard layouts resolve automatically, override for custom ones.
ltx23_timestep_sampling: Flow-matching timestep sampling; shift-biased is the default choice.
ltx23_video_vae_path: Video VAE matching the base; standard layouts resolve automatically, override for custom ones.
lulynx_down_lr_weight: SDXL Encoder Layer Learning Rate Weight, 9
lulynx_experimental_core_enabled: Enables the Lulynx core hub managing SafeGuard/EMA/ResourceManager together. Turn on when you need any of them.
lulynx_freq_texture_enabled: Latent frequency-domain texture loss as an aux objective for texture-heavy goals.
lulynx_freq_texture_highpass_sigma: Gaussian sigma separating high/low bands. Recommended: keep 2.
lulynx_freq_texture_max_t: Upper raw-sigma bound included. Recommended: 1 covers all.
lulynx_freq_texture_min_t: Lower raw-sigma bound included. Recommended: 0 covers all.
lulynx_freq_texture_weight: Texture-loss weight. Recommended: probe from small values.
lulynx_latent_anchor_enabled: Latent perceptual anchor via multi-scale gradient matching. Try when detail decays.
lulynx_latent_anchor_grad_scales: Pyramid depth for multi-scale matching. Recommended: keep 3.
lulynx_latent_anchor_perceptor: Feature backend for anchoring. latent_msgrad default.
lulynx_latent_anchor_weight: Anchor loss weight. Recommended: probe from small values.
lulynx_ln_guard: LNGuard anchors learnable norm parameters against drift (safe no-op without trainable norms). Try when style drifts.
lulynx_ln_lambda: Mean-square drift weight for norms. Recommended: light anchoring at 0.01.
lulynx_mid_lr_weight: SDXL Mid Layer Learning Rate Weight, 3
lulynx_optimization_enabled: System-level optimization bundle (swap pipelining, async D2H, stream-ordered prefetch, TREAD/DiffCR skipping). Enable for throughput once stable.
lulynx_precision_swap_enabled: Precision swap planner layer; pick one swap scheme, do not stack them.
lulynx_precision_swap_strategy: Strategy name for precision swap. Keep standard.
lulynx_resource_log_interval: Resource-log cadence in steps. Recommended: keep 25.
lulynx_resource_manager_enabled: Periodically clears caches against fragmentation OOM. Enable for fragmentation issues.
lulynx_smart_rank_enabled: SmartRank periodically prunes low-energy rank channels. Try for overfitting or oversized files.
lulynx_smart_rank_keep_ratio: Share of rank channels kept (0.75 drops weakest 25%). Recommended: 0.75-0.9.
lulynx_steady_accel: Steady-state operator pack for Anima/Newbie (Triton inject + TC-FMT + fused RoPE); auto gates per family. Keep auto.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_enabled: Reconstructs gradients through low-rank double projections; optimizer state stays full-size (not GaLore). Experimental.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_rank: Subspace rank for gradient filtering. Recommended: keep 64.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_scale: Scale applied to filtered gradients. Recommended: keep 1.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_update_interv: Basis refresh interval in steps. Recommended: keep 100.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_warmup_steps: Full-gradient warmup steps before filtering. Recommended: keep 0.
lulynx_up_lr_weight: SDXL Decoder Layer Learning Rate Weight, 9
lulynx_weight_noise_bound_norm: Restores tensor norms after noising to curb drift. Pair with long runs.
lulynx_weight_noise_enabled: Injects noise into LoRA weights every step as regularization. Anti-overfitting experiment.
lulynx_weight_noise_log_every: Metric logging cadence; 0 silences. Recommended: keep 50.
lulynx_weight_noise_mode: relative scales with weight RMS; absolute is fixed. relative is more robust.
lulynx_weight_noise_sigma: Noise scale; relative mode multiplies RMS. Recommended: around default 0.0125.
lulynx_weight_residency: Layer residency for the frozen SDXL base: resident is fastest, others trade IO for VRAM. Keep resident when it fits.
lulynx_weight_residency_min_params: Param-count floor for managed layers. Recommended: keep 0.
lycoris_algo: Concrete LyCORIS algorithm from the natively supported set. LoCon is a sensible start.
lycoris_preset: Preset passed to the LyCORIS library.
lycoris_train_norm: Also train normalization layers (LayerNorm/RMSNorm) alongside the LoRA. Backend field name lycoris_train_norm; try for character fidelity, keep off normally.
machine_rank: This node rank in multi-node jobs. Recommended: single-node keeps 0.
main_process_ip: Address of the rendezvous node. Required for multi-node runs and ignored on a single machine.
main_process_port: Master rendezvous port. Recommended: default 29500; change only if occupied.
masked_loss: Compute loss only inside mask regions (requires mask images). Enable for subject-only learning with region annotations.
max_bucket_reso: Largest allowed bucket edge; at most ~2x resolution. Recommended: cache-first replay typically reuses build-time resolution.
max_grad_norm: Global-norm clip threshold against exploding gradients. Recommended: keep default 1.0 for LoRA and full finetune alike.
max_timestep: Upper timestep bound trimming the high-noise range. Recommended: empty covers all; lower to focus on detail.
max_token_length: Token truncation cap for text encoders; 225 (=75x3) is common, minimum 75. Recommended: shorter focuses on the subject.
max_train_epochs: Max passes over the dataset; sets total training amount. Recommended: 10-30 epochs for small datasets (<50 images), 1-5 for large ones. Set either this or max_train_steps.
max_train_steps: Controls training length by optimizer updates, more precise than epochs. Recommended: 0 to disable; 1000-5000 steps is typical for LoRA.
max_validation_steps: Max batches per validation pass. Recommended: 20-100; 0/empty unlimited.
mem_eff_attn: Force the conservative memory-efficient attention path. Off by default.
mem_eff_save: Streams checkpoints out with a lower peak RAM footprint at the cost of some save time. Enable when saving large finetunes on constrained hosts.
memory_reclaim_interval_steps: Periodic gc+empty_cache every N steps against fragmentation. Recommended: 50-200 only when needed; 0 off.
memory_reclaim_on_circuit_open: GPU OPEN When Force reclaim. Default Enable.
merge_ed_lora_fusion: Gradient-descent weight fusion at merge/export time (less alignment drift than plain add); never touches the training loop. Enable for multi-adapter merges.
merge_export: Bake the LoRA into the base and save a dense model after training. Enable only when delivering merged artifacts.
min_bucket_reso: Smallest allowed bucket edge. Recommended: use >=256 and not far below half of resolution to avoid extreme stretching.
min_snr_gamma: Down-weights high-SNR timesteps to balance learning stages. Recommended: 5 (paper value); 3 mild; 8 for small datasets emphasizing detail; 0/empty disables.
min_timestep: Lower timestep bound trimming the low-noise range. Recommended: empty covers all.
mixed_precision: Mixed precision: low-precision compute with FP32 master weights. bf16 is most stable (required on RTX30+/A100); fp16 for older cards; 'no' means full-precision training for debugging. Recommended: bf16.
mode_scale: Mode-weighting scale (EDM2 style). Recommended: leave empty to disable.
model_family: Model-family identifier used by the few-step distillation routes; not user-facing.
model_fused_qkv: Physically fused QKV/KV weight packing used as fallback when Triton QKV misses. Off by default.
model_prediction_type: Prediction parameterization reported by the model (raw, additive or sigma_scaled). Fixed per family; not user-facing.
model_to_condition_enabled: Enables the shared ModelToCondition protocol used by specific pipelines.
model_train_type: Training-type identifier forwarded to the backend; fixed per schema and not user-facing.
model_type: Base-model family identifier forwarded to the backend; fixed per schema and not user-facing.
module_dropout: Whole-module random drop probability. Recommended: default 0; try within 0.1 max.
module_offload_backbone_ratio: Override share for backbone modules; empty inherits the global ratio. Recommended: leave empty.
module_offload_enabled: Master switch moving a share of frozen Linear/Conv modules to CPU. Next lever when block swap is not enough.
module_offload_enhanced: Enhanced scheduling variant of module offload. Try when the preset falls short.
module_offload_exclude_patterns: Name patterns excluded from offloading. Protect sensitive layers here.
module_offload_include_patterns: Comma-separated name patterns restricting what gets offloaded. For surgical control.
module_offload_min_param_mb: Only modules above this size get offloaded to avoid tiny transfers. Recommended: keep 10 MB.
module_offload_prefetch_enabled: Prefetches the next module ahead of use. Keep true.
module_offload_prefetch_mode: Prefetch implementation; experimental is the only mode today.
module_offload_profile: Offload preset: balanced, aggressive (leaner slower), conservative (faster), custom. Keep balanced.
module_offload_profile_enabled: Use the preset profile instead of manual subfields. Keep true.
module_offload_ratio: Share of manageable modules offloaded (not a VRAM target). Recommended: probe 30-70%.
module_offload_text_encoder_ratio: Override share for text encoders; empty inherits global. Recommended: leave empty.
module_offload_verify_state: Verifies module state after each transfer, notably slower. Debugging aid only.
mora_enabled: MoRA replaces BA with an r x r square matrix (r^2 params); exports a dedicated format, not A1111-native. Experimental.
multi_aspect_guidance_adaptive_weights: Adapts scorer weights per aspect automatically. Keep true.
multi_aspect_guidance_aspect_weights: JSON weights per guidance aspect, for example {"style":1.0,"character":1.5}. Empty weights every aspect equally.
multi_aspect_guidance_custom_scorers: JSON map from aspect name to a custom scorer path. Empty uses the built-in scorers.
multi_aspect_guidance_default_scorer: Scorer used when no custom one is set. latent_style_contras default is reasonable.
multi_aspect_guidance_enabled: Multi-aspect guidance weights style/character scorers into the objective. For aesthetics-driven goals.
multi_aspect_guidance_max_t: Upper σ bound applying guidance. Recommended: keep 1.
multi_aspect_guidance_min_t: Lower σ bound applying guidance. Recommended: keep 0.
multi_aspect_guidance_weight: Total guidance weight. Recommended: probe upward from small values.
multi_scale_loss_type: Feature loss type for mid layers. Start with mse.
multi_scale_max_t: Upper σ bound for supervision. Recommended: keep 1.
multi_scale_min_t: Lower σ bound applying supervision. Recommended: keep 0.
multi_scale_supervision_enabled: Student-teacher feature supervision at DiT mid-layers (4/8/12). Try when deep semantics lag.
multires_noise_discount: Decay across pyramid-noise layers; lower means less high-frequency energy. Recommended: 0.3-0.8.
multires_noise_iterations: Pyramid-noise iteration count for smoother multi-scale noise. Recommended: 6-10 with discount enabled; 0 disables.
native_cache_mode: Anima cache mode: reuse (cache_first), online top-up, forced rebuild, or build-only-and-exit. Keep cache_first.
native_resume_save_precision: Precision of native resume sidecars: float preserves masters exactly (default); half types halve size but resume from rounded weights.
native_runtime_profile: Native-runtime speed profile: aggressive exists for SDXL; DiT fast tiers for Anima/Newbie; lean/experimental tiers are Anima-only. Keep standard.
nccl_socket_ifname: Network interface name for NCCL (multi-node Ethernet).
negative_semantic_regularization_enabled: Constrains LoRA-on/off deltas under negative prompts to curb unwanted semantic bleed. Try against false triggers.
negative_semantic_regularization_mode: Only lora_delta is implemented server-side today. Keep it.
network_alpha: Scaling factor: effective LR is about lr x alpha/rank. Recommended: alpha = rank or rank/2 (e.g. 16-32 when rank=32); lower the ratio at high rank.
network_args_custom: Extra network/LoRA kwargs. One key=value per line.
target_modules: Override the default target layers: comma- or newline-separated module names (e.g. to_q,to_v,to_out.0). Empty = per-type default preset. The submit layer splits this into an array for the backend.
rank_strategy: Rank allocation strategy (module_group_registry.py:328): uniform applies the same rank everywhere (default); module_group/module follow module-group presets; auto_static/dynamic infer from structure. Non-uniform strategies are experimental.
network_dim: LoRA rank: low-rank subspace size driving capacity and file size. Recommended: 4-128; start at 32-64 for characters/styles, 8-16 for simple concepts.
network_dropout: Randomly zeroes LoRA output units as regularization. Recommended: 0 (default) or at most 0.1.
network_module: Network module picks the adapter implementation. networks.lora has the best compatibility; lora_fa/vera/tlora/flexrank are experimental; lycoris.kohya is the legacy entry.
network_train_text_encoder_only: Train the text encoder only (backbone frozen). For vocabulary/language binding experiments only.
network_train_unet_only: Train the U-Net/DiT backbone only (TE frozen). Standard for most LoRA goals focused on visuals rather than new vocabulary.
network_weights: Continue training from an existing LoRA (additive, not reset). Match its dim/alpha; mind base-model drift.
newbie_auto_swap_release: Gradually reduces swap count when VRAM stays low, buying back speed. Enable for long adaptive runs.
newbie_block_checkpointing: Primary Newbie checkpointing: per-block recompute beats generic checkpointing on VRAM. Prefer it first.
newbie_block_checkpointing_interval: Checkpoint every N DiT blocks (1 = all). Larger N recomputes less but holds more activations. Recommended: 1.
newbie_block_checkpointing_mode: Checkpointing style: full block recompute (recommended) or selective aligned with Anima.
newbie_block_prefetch: Newbie prefetch toggle to hide swap latency alongside offload.
newbie_block_prefetch_mode: Fixed-depth vs adaptive prefetch. Keep original.
newbie_block_residency: Residency policy for frozen Newbie DiT weights. block_cpu_pinned balances VRAM and speed well.
newbie_block_residency_min_params: Only offload frozen Linears above this param count to cut transfer overhead. Recommended: keep 0 to include all.
newbie_cache_build_batch_size: Images encoded per batch during first cache build. Recommended: 8; halve on OOM.
newbie_cache_build_prefetch: CPU thread pre-decodes the next batch during first build to overlap GPU encoding. Enable with spare RAM.
newbie_caption_length_bucket_size: Caption-length bucket size to cut padding waste. Recommended: 0 auto or 32-128.
newbie_clip_max_token_length: Token cap for the Newbie CLIP channel. Recommended: stay within 2048 as needed.
newbie_force_cache_only: Builds/completes the cache and exits early without entering the training loop; intended for pre-processing large datasets. Combined with force-rebuild-cache, it only rebuilds the cache and skips training.
newbie_gemma_max_token_length: Token cap for the Newbie Gemma channel. Recommended: 512.
newbie_rebuild_cache: Ignores existing caches and rebuilds everything. Run once after data/label changes.
newbie_safe_fallback: Automatically retries with a more conservative Newbie setup after OOM. Keep on for survival.
newbie_sigma_schedule: Noise-sigma distribution preset for Newbie training. standard is the reference implementation default, plain logit-normal(0,1) with no resolution bias; lulynx layers a resolution-dependent flow shift on the same sampling so more of the noise budget lands in the high-noise region (larger shift at higher resolution), and preview follows the same transform as training. An explicit ddpm_timestep_sampling or FasterDiT SNR takes precedence. Start on standard; A/B against lulynx when output looks flat or lacks high-noise detail.
newbie_target_modules: Target module list, one per line.
nl_dropout_rate: Dropout probability for NL descriptions in structured JSON. Recommended: 0-0.1.
no_half_vae: Forces FP32 VAE to fix gray/NaN outputs from some half-precision VAEs. Try when previews look washed out.
no_metadata: Omit training metadata from artifacts. Enable for sensitive releases; keep off otherwise for traceability.
noise_offset: Adds a constant offset to noise, improving very dark/bright generations. Recommended: 0.05-0.08, up to 0.1 for extreme lighting data; 0 disables.
noise_offset_random_strength: Randomizes offset strength between 0 and the set value for diversity. Keep off normally; consider for wide dynamic-range datasets.
noise_weighting_enabled: sigma; DDPM Auto From alpha_cumprod Noise.
noise_weighting_mode: Noise-weight strength: 0 identity, 1 standard tilt, cap 4. Recommended: 0.25-1 when combined with other axes.
noise_weighting_strength: Recommended: noise-weight strength: 0 identity, 1 standard tilt, cap 4.
num_class_images: Number of generated class images (0 = none). Recommended: 100-200, same scale as training images; runtime default 100.
num_machines: Total machines in the job. Recommended: 1 for single-node setups.
num_processes: Processes launched on this machine. Recommended: leave empty to infer from GPU count.
num_vectors_per_token: Learned vectors per placeholder token (TI capacity). Recommended: 1-4; higher is harder to converge.
num_workers: DataLoader workers (alias entry). Recommended: 2-8; 0 loads in-process.
oom_skip_batch_enabled: Skips batches that trigger OOM so unattended runs survive. Keep on (default).
oom_skip_batch_max_consecutive: Stops the run after this many consecutive OOM skips. Recommended: 3.
opt_adafactor_relative_step: Adafactor relative-step self-scaling. Keep off to train with a fixed LR; on ignores learning_rate.
opt_adafactor_scale_parameter: By Params Learning Rate (Recommended Disable, lr).
opt_adafactor_warmup_init: Warmup init for Adafactor relative_step. Keep off.
opt_adamw_bf16_note: Only bf16 Training Params; moments And residual In fp32. And TurboCore fused multi-tensor / gradient_release full. lr/betas/wd Or optimizer_args_custom.
opt_adan_beta3: Adan third-momentum coefficient for gradient-difference EMA. Recommended: 0.99 (paper value).
opt_adan_no_prox: Disable Adan proximal update (changes decay behavior). Keep false to match the paper.
opt_ademamix_t_alpha_beta3: Warmup steps ramping alpha/beta3; 0 disables. Recommended: consider ~2000 for long runs.
opt_adopt_clip_lambda: ADOPT clip lambda guarding early steps. Recommended: ~0.1; 0 disables.
opt_adopt_eps: ADOPT numerical-stability epsilon. Recommended: keep default 1e-6.
opt_aurora_damping: Row-norm balancing strength for Aurora, 0-1. Recommended: keep 0.5.
opt_aurora_nesterov: Nesterov momentum for Aurora. Keep on.
opt_aurora_ns_steps: Newton-Schulz iterations for Aurora orthogonalization. Recommended: 6.
opt_aurora_pp_iterations: Leverage-score balancing projections for Aurora. Recommended: 2.
opt_came_eps_group: Per-group epsilon for CAME. Recommended: keep 1e-8.
opt_came_eps_rho: Curvature epsilon for CAME. Recommended: keep 1e-6.
opt_dadapt_d0: Initial DAdaptation step-size estimate. Recommended: 1e-6 (lets it self-scale).
opt_dadapt_growth_rate: Upper bound on DAdaptation growth rate. Recommended: leave empty for default; too small throttles adaptation.
opt_kahan8bit_block_size: Block size for KahanAdamW8bit quantization. Recommended: 2048; power-of-two 64..4096.
opt_kahan8bit_min_8bit_size: Tensors below this element count stay fp32 to avoid quantization noise. Recommended: 4096.
opt_kron_precond_update_prob: Probability of refreshing Kron preconditioner per step. Recommended: 0.03.
opt_lion_use_triton: Accelerate Lion with a Triton fused kernel. Enable on NVIDIA with Triton available; falls back on failure.
opt_mars_ams_bound: AMSBound-style second moment for MARS. Keep off by default.
opt_mars_cautious: Cautious mask keeps only same-sign update components. Worth enabling for stability.
opt_mars_optimize_1d: Off: 1D parameters (bias/norm) use built-in AdamW; on: MARS updates them too.
opt_muon_nesterov: Nesterov lookahead momentum for Muon. Keep on (usually better).
opt_riemannion_orthogonalize: Orthogonalize updates via Newton-Schulz. Keep on for stable manifold steps.
opt_riemannion_solve_eps: Numerical damping epsilon for Riemannion. Recommended: keep 1e-6.
opt_rose_gradient_centralization: Gradient centralization for Rose. Keep on; often helps generalization.
opt_rose_stochastic_rounding: Stochastic rounding for low-precision updates. Keep on to reduce bias buildup.
opt_sf_warmup_steps: Recommended: schedule-Free internal warmup; prefer this over external warmup, 100-500 steps or 0.
opt_soap_precondition_frequency: Steps between SOAP preconditioner updates. Recommended: 10; higher saves time but adapts slower.
opt_soap_shampoo_beta: Shampoo factor EMA coefficient; -1 follows beta1. Recommended: keep -1.
opt_sophia_update_period: Steps between Hessian-diagonal estimates. Recommended: 10; larger is faster but coarser.
opt_spam_density: Momentum sparsification fraction; 0 keeps dense. Recommended: keep 0.
opt_spam_gamma: SPAM momentum-reset threshold relative to mean gradient. Recommended: 2.
optimizer_args_custom: Extra optimizer kwargs (backend optimizer_args). One key=value per line.
optimizer_backend: AdamW backend implementation (torch/foreach/fused/bnb...); numerically equivalent with different speed/memory. Keep auto.
optimizer_state_paging_enabled: Pages large optimizer states to CPU between steps. Helps big-rank AdamW under VRAM pressure.
optimizer_state_paging_min_tensor_mb: Page only states above this MB. Recommended: >=1 MB.
optimizer_state_paging_pin_memory: Persistent pinned mirror with a copy stream speeds paging. Enable with spare RAM.
optimizer_state_paging_storage_device: Where paged states live: cpu frees VRAM; param follows parameters. Choose cpu.
optimizer_state_paging_storage_dtype: Host-copy dtype: preserve exact; bf16/fp8 compress. Precision restores before step. Keep preserve.
optimizer_type: Optimizer controls weight updates and drives stability/VRAM. AdamW8bit is the safe default; Prodigy/AutoProdigy self-tune step size; ScheduleFree variants need no scheduler. Recommended: AdamW8bit + cosine.
original_image_path: ADDifT Original Image. And Target Image.
output_dir: Folder where trained models are written. Point to a dedicated drive/folder, separate from caches and datasets.
output_name: Output filename without extension. Name as concept+version (e.g. lulu_v2) and avoid reusing names in one folder.
p2_weighting_mode: Perception weighting: p2=(k+SNR)^-gamma paper form; lulynx structure/detail variants; off identity. Keep off unless composition/detail balance skews.
p2_weighting_strength: P2 strength gamma. Recommended: start 0.5-1; 0 disables; validate gains via A/B.
pattern_loss_enabled: Pattern Loss applies losses per DWT band (low-freq LL vs high-freq LH/HL/HH) for structure-vs-detail control. Use to discipline textures deliberately.
pattern_loss_high_huber_c: Huber delta for the high band. Recommended: keep 0.1.
pattern_loss_high_type: High-band loss type; huber resists outlier ripples.
pattern_loss_levels: DWT decomposition levels. Recommended: 1-4; more means larger-scale constraints.
pattern_loss_ll_type: Loss type for the low-frequency band. l2 preserves global structure best.
pattern_loss_ll_weight: Low-band weight. Recommended: 1; higher suppresses high-frequency learning.
pcgrad_conflict_threshold: Cosine below this counts as conflict (0 = project all). Recommended: keep 0.
pcgrad_enabled: PCGrad projects conflicting gradients orthogonally; useful with several combined losses.
pcgrad_reduction: Reduction before projection. mean is standard.
pcie_delta_cache_budget_mb: GPU-side cache budget in MB; start at 256. Recommended: 0 disables caching.
pcie_delta_cache_enabled: Observation-only candidate report for PCIe delta caching. Diagnostic aid.
pcie_delta_cache_mode: observe reports only; cache_v0 enables actual caching. Observe first.
pcie_transfer_format: Transfer format for pinned frozen weights over PCIe. Start off; pick a format only after measuring bandwidth limits.
peak_vram_auto_protection_enabled: Dynamically sheds load as VRAM approaches the ceiling. Good for unattended runs.
peak_vram_control_enabled: Parent switch for peak-VRAM controls (micro-batching, startup guard). Enable for OOM-driven scenarios.
peak_vram_diagnostics_enabled: Emit peak-VRAM diagnostic logs during training.
peak_vram_diagnostics_interval: Print VRAM diagnostics every N steps while debugging. Recommended: disable once stable.
peak_vram_micro_batch_enabled: Splits the batch into micro-batches to cut peaks. Useful when batch >1 OOMs.
peak_vram_micro_batch_size: Samples per micro-batch. Recommended: 1-2; smaller leans harder.
peak_vram_startup_guard_enabled: Guards the startup window where first-step peaks OOM most often. Enable when trialing big models.
peak_vram_startup_guard_mode: Guard intensity; auto estimates the level. Keep auto.
peak_vram_startup_guard_steps: Steps the startup guard stays active. Recommended: ~24.
peak_vram_target_effective_batch: Target effective batch guiding the splitter; 0 auto. Recommended: keep 0.
performance_expert_mode: Reveals expert performance options (compile backends, Triton optimizers, swap strategies). Keep off until tuning.
perlin_noise_offset_enabled: Replaces uniform noise_offset with spatially coherent Perlin fields. Compare head-to-head with plain offset.
perlin_noise_offset_scale: Perlin field frequency; higher means finer texture. Recommended: keep ~4.
perlin_noise_offset_strength: Recommended: perlin overlay strength; similar magnitude to noise_offset (~0.1).
persistent_data_loader_workers: Keeps workers alive between epochs to skip respawn cost. Keep on for larger datasets (default).
pissa_apply_conv2d: Apply PiSSA init to 1x1 Convs too. Enable for consistent treatment when Conv targets exist.
pissa_export_mode: How PiSSA models export to standard LoRA (whether the base absorbs residuals). lora_compatible loads anywhere.
pissa_init: PiSSA initializes LoRA from leading SVD components for faster convergence. Good for medium/large datasets; check export mode for compatibility.
pissa_method: PiSSA factorization algorithm: fast randomized rsvd vs exact svd. Keep rsvd.
pissa_niter: Power iterations for randomized SVD; more is accurate but slower. Recommended: keep 2.
pissa_oversample: Oversampling dimension for randomized SVD. Recommended: keep 8.
pixel_space_augmentation_enabled: Pixel-side augmentation paired with pixel-space training.
pixel_space_enabled: Supervises directly in pixel space bypassing the VAE: experimental and VRAM-hungry. Research use only.
pixel_space_input_channels: Pixel input channels, normally 3 for RGB. Recommended: keep 3.
pixel_space_loss_type: Pixel-space loss flavor: mse/l1/lpips/hybrid. hybrid balances structure and perception.
pixel_space_loss_weights: JSON weights for the pixel-space loss terms, for example {"mse":1.0,"lpips":0.0}. Raise lpips only when perceptual sharpness matters more than fidelity.
preference_models: Comma-separated: pickscore,imagereward,hpsv2. Empty = pickscore only. Missing weights are marked skipped, never silent 0.
preference_scoring_enabled: After training, score generated images with PickScore / ImageReward / HPSv2. Heavy weights; default off. Requires quality evaluation enabled.
prefetch_factor: Batches each worker prefetches ahead. Recommended: 2; 4 on slow IO.
pretrained_model_name_or_path: Anima DiT Weight; BF16 And Bedovyy/Comfy INT8 (int8rowwise/int8convrot). INT8 Training Before dequant dense, Training VRAM ≈BF16 (Disk, keep-I8, Comfy)
preview_device: Device for preview inference: gpu fast, cpu VRAM-free but slow. Keep gpu unless the profile says otherwise.
preview_groups: Add multiple preview groups, each with its own seed and LoRA.
prior_loss_weight: Weight of the prior-preservation term relative to main loss. Recommended: 1.0 default or 0.5-1; needs a regularization set.
prodigy_d0: Prodigy initial step-size estimate. Recommended: 1e-6 (safest start).
prodigy_d_coef: Prodigy step-size multiplier. Recommended: 1.0; above 1 gets aggressive.
progressive_curriculum_seed: Recommended: seed for in-stage curriculum picks; keep 42 for reproducibility.
progressive_phase_schedule: JSON Or {"phases": [...]}. start/end (0~1), lr_scale, module_policy, difficulty_policy, timestep_policy Etc.; Empty Compatible Default.
progressive_training_enabled: Switch training stages by optimizer progress (per-stage LR/modules/curriculum). Best for long fine-tuning projects.
pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments: Sets expandable_segments allocator config before training to reduce fragmentation OOM. Keep on (default).
quality_evaluation_compare_base: Generates paired samples at LoRA weight 0 vs 1 to isolate adapter contribution. Keep on.
quality_evaluation_enabled: Runs FID/CLIP-score style metrics after training for batch-to-batch comparison.
quality_evaluation_metric_weights: Weights for combining metrics into one score. Equal weights are fine until you have a preference.
quality_evaluation_metrics: Which metrics to compute (FID/CLIP...). Pair FID with CLIP score for complementary signals.
quality_evaluation_suite_id: Evaluation suite preset id. Start with the default suite.
quality_evaluation_validation_prompts: Validation prompts for evaluation; cover core concepts and known failure modes.
quality_evaluation_validation_seeds: Seeds for evaluation runs to keep results comparable. Reuse a fixed set.
quality_evaluation_xy_grid: Builds XY grids (e.g. weight x seed matrices) for visual comparison during tuning.
quant_requantize_policy: Requantization policy for already-quantized bases; avoid sidesteps double-quantization noise. Keep avoid.
quant_train_convrot: Applies true group-RHT rotation in keep_w8 mode matching Comfy convrot exports. Enable for export compatibility.
quant_train_mode: Off (default) = normal training: dequantize first if the loaded model is quantized. On = keep backbone weights frozen in INT8, train only high-precision LoRA (saves VRAM, only meaningful for quantized model packs). Mutually exclusive with vendor keep_storage (some FP8).
quantization_enabled: Quantized base loading (QLoRA family) for major base-VRAM savings when half precision still will not fit.
quantization_legacy_target_tables: Pre-fix legacy quant target tables for reproducing old artifacts only. Keep off for new runs.
quantization_offload_optimizer_states: Also pages optimizer states to CPU in quantized training. Slower but helps at the extreme.
quantization_type: Base quantization backend for QLoRA-style loading. nf4 balances quality and speed best.
qwen3: Qwen3 Text Model Path. Fill File Or Model Directory
qwen3_max_token_length: Max Qwen3 tokens. Recommended: within default 512; longer costs speed/cache.
random_crop: Random crop augmentation for composition variety; disable if it crops out subjects.
random_triggers: Comma-separated trigger-word list or a file path.
random_triggers_position: Where injected trigger words land in the caption. prepend keeps them first (recommended).
random_triggers_probability: Probability of injecting a random trigger. Recommended: 1.0 always; 0 disables.
rank_comp_activation_weighted: Activation-energy-weighted factorization minimizing output error (~16 points better). Recommended on; auto-degrades without caches in place.
rank_comp_calibration_batches: Cached samples used to estimate channel energy. Recommended: keep 8.
rank_comp_calibration_ridge: Ridge term stabilizing energy inversion. Recommended: keep 1e-3.
rank_comp_enabled: Low-rank compensation restores accuracy lost to 4-bit bases (~0.4% backbone VRAM at r16). Enable when quantization visibly hurts.
rank_comp_export_sidecar: Exports the compensator as a separate *.rank_comp.safetensors (never bake into LoRA — it breaks on unquantized bases).
rank_comp_niter: Power iterations for randomized SVD. Recommended: keep 4.
rank_comp_oversample: Oversampling columns improving small-singular-value accuracy. Recommended: keep 8.
rank_comp_rank: Compensation rank: r16 removes ~32% error, r64 ~65%, costing more VRAM. Recommended: range 16-64.
rank_comp_refine_iters: Recommended: alternating refinement rounds; diminishing returns past 2.
rank_comp_target_suffixes: Comma-separated module-name suffixes to compensate; empty follows the quantization target table of the architecture.
rank_dropout: Per-rank/output-dim dropout for LoKr-style variants. Recommended: default 0; experiment within 0.1.
real_objective: Objective for true smoke runs (lcm_consistency_prob aligns against teacher targets). Default suits most probes.
reft_enabled: ReFT steers intermediate representations instead of weights. Experimental; enable only to probe this low-parameter route.
reft_init_scale: Recommended: initial scale of intervention matrices; start from 0.
reft_rank: Rank of the intervention subspace. Recommended: ~8.
reg_data_dir: Regularization-image folder for prior preservation with prior_loss_weight. Provide class images only when fighting catastrophic forgetting.
region_focus_coverage_balance: Boosts loss weight when target regions are tiny relative to the frame (no step dropping). Good for small subjects.
region_focus_coverage_max_boost: Upper bound of coverage boosting. Recommended: keep 2.
region_focus_coverage_target: Coverage ratio below which boosting starts. Recommended: around default 0.05.
region_focus_decay: Linearly decays focus toward the floor as training progresses. Keep true.
region_focus_enabled: Layers a focus strength and step-wise decay on top of semantic region weighting; enabling it forces semantic region weighting on in the backend. Try it when a local feature needs extra pull.
region_focus_floor: Floor multiplier reached at end of training. Recommended: keep 0.25.
region_focus_strength: Amplifies deviations of region weights from 1.0; 1 uses tables as-is. Recommended: keep 1.
repa_allow_text_fallback: Legacy fallback aligning against text embeddings — fake signal. Keep off.
repa_capture_max_layers: Max DiT hooks attached; loss uses the last one. Recommended: keep 1.
repa_capture_modules_auto: Auto-picks a single mid-layer hook per family when targets are empty. Keep true.
repa_dinov2_model: DINOv2 backbone id used as the REPA teacher encoder.
repa_enabled: Classic REPA: align DiT intermediate features to an external vision encoder. Usually slower and more VRAM-heavy.
repa_encode_every_n_steps: Runs encoder/VAE decode every N steps to bound cost (1 = every step). Recommended: 4 on 16 GB.
repa_encoder_device: Device hosting the DINOv2/Jina weights. Recommended: cpu to save VRAM (default); cuda when headroom allows.
repa_encoder_image_size: Encoder input edge; 0 keeps per-model defaults (dino~224, jina~512). Recommended: keep 0.
repa_gram_spatial_norm: L2-normalize tokens before Gram computation. Keep true.
repa_gram_weight: Gram-term weight for the relational arm; 0 falls back to the main weight. Recommended: start 0.
repa_log_memory: Logs shapes and memory on first real REPA loss. Keep true to gauge overhead.
repa_loss_type: Alignment loss: cosine direction-only (stable default) vs mse magnitude-aware. Prefer cosine.
repa_loss_weight: Auxiliary alignment weight; 0 disables in practice. Recommended: probe from 0.1-0.5.
repa_mode: REPA alignment mode: absolute direct matching vs relational structure. Start with absolute.
repa_patch_size: Recommended: diT patch size used by relational pooling; anima usually 2.
repa_projection_dim: Projection width before aligning; 0 uses backend default. Recommended: keep 0.
repa_target_modules: Module. Empty + auto → Backend By Layer mid (hook).
repa_target_provider: Provider of REPA alignment targets (DINOv2/Jina vision encoders); none fails closed rather than faking alignment. Pick only with a real encoder available.
repa_token_pool_size: Pools tokens to at most N x N before alignment/Gram (16 ~ 256 tokens). Recommended: keep 16.
reslora_alpha_star: Merge coefficient for input/middle shortcuts. Recommended: keep 1.0.
reslora_enabled: ResLoRA adds cross-block residual shortcuts, helping high ranks. Try from rank >=32 with tuned alpha*.
reslora_window: Blocks the shortcut looks back across; 1 is near no-op. Recommended: 2.
resolution: Training resolution "width,height", multiples of 64. Match your base model: 1024,1024 for SDXL/Flux/Anima, 512,512 for SD1.5.
resolution_aware_batch_base_resolution: Resolution at which train_batch_size applies as-is. Recommended: set to your common resolution.
resolution_aware_batch_enabled: Scales effective batch with input resolution to steady VRAM on mixed-size datasets.
resolution_aware_batch_max_factor: Max batch upscale factor for small images. Recommended: 2-4.
resolution_aware_batch_min_factor: Min batch downscale factor for large images. Recommended: 0.25-0.5.
resume: Resume from a save-state directory (folder, not file). Resume only with the same code version/config to stay compatible.
route_status_note: Status note for this route: the Qwen Image entry is a lightweight selector only and its training core is not wired up yet.
rs_lora_enabled: RS-LoRA scales alpha by sqrt(rank) for stability at high rank. Enable for rank >=64; little gain below.
runtime_features_detail: Verbosity of runtime stats; off normally, pick a level while debugging.
safeguard_auto_reduce_lr: Auto-lowers LR when protection triggers. Useful for recurring mild spikes.
safeguard_enabled: SafeGuard intercepts NaN/Inf and loss spikes. Worth it on unattended long runs.
safeguard_loss_spike_threshold: Multiple of rolling mean treated as a spike and skipped. Recommended: keep 5.
safeguard_loss_window_size: Rolling window for spike detection. Recommended: keep 20.
safeguard_lr_reduction_factor: LR multiplier applied on guard trips. Recommended: halving (0.5) is typical.
safeguard_max_nan_count: Consecutive NaN events before aborting. Recommended: keep 3.
safeguard_nan_check_interval: NaN/Inf check cadence. Recommended: 1 is most responsive.
safeguard_safe_state_interval: Rollback snapshot cadence including momentum state. Recommended: 100 balances cost.
sageattn: Force SageAttention as an override; default follows the launcher environment.
sample_algorithm: Solver used for in-training previews: sde runs ER-SDE-Solver-3 with an annealed stochastic term (default), ode follows a deterministic Euler path with no noise injection. Keep sde; switch to ode with SDE eta at 0 when you need step-by-step comparability.
sample_at_first: Renders one preview before training starts to validate prompts early. Useful on first runs.
sample_cache_seam_backend: Preview acceleration backend: Spectrum block-cache extrapolation vs SmoothCache error gating. Spectrum first.
sample_cache_seam_window_size: History window length for linear extrapolation. Recommended: keep 3.
sample_cfg: Preview CFG scale. Recommended: ~7 normally; 1-2 for LCM-style models.
sample_difficulty_metadata_path: JSON File. Empty When Auto <train_data_dir>/sample_difficulty.json; Path Auto Path.
sample_difficulty_weighting_enabled: Emphasize hard/easy samples via dataset weights or detached batch loss. Off by default; enable once weight sources are trusted.
sample_difficulty_weighting_max: Upper clamp on difficulty weights. Recommended: 4.
sample_difficulty_weighting_min: Lower clamp on difficulty weights. Recommended: 0.25.
sample_difficulty_weighting_mode: Difficulty source: provided dataset weights vs automatic loss-derived. Prefer provided.
sample_difficulty_weighting_strength: Difficulty-weight strength: 0 identity, 1 standard tilt. Recommended: 0.25-1 when combined with other axes.
sample_every: Backend primary cadence key: preview every N steps (same intent as sample_every_n_steps). Recommended: fill one of them.
sample_every_n_epochs: Preview every N epochs. Recommended: 1-4; 0 disables epoch-based sampling.
sample_every_n_steps: Preview every N steps for finer granularity. Recommended: 200-1000; 0 disables.
sample_fsg_apply: Probe-only when off; actually bends the trajectory when on. Probe first.
sample_fsg_band_end: End of the guided sigma band. Recommended: keep 0.85.
sample_fsg_band_start: Start of the guided sigma band. Recommended: keep 0.45.
sample_fsg_k: Number of FSG orders/groups. Recommended: keep 3.
sample_height: Recommended: preview height in px; same guidance as width.
sample_negative: Negative prompt for previews; keep generic quality terms consistent with your target usage.
sample_prompts: Preview prompt list (one per line with optional suffix params). Cover typical scenes and trigger combos.
sample_sampler: Preview sampler (canonical names; legacy names alias at runtime). euler_a for quick trends, karras variants for detail.
sample_scheduler: Preview scheduler; empty follows the model default.
sample_sde_eta: Scales the stochastic term of the sde solver; 1.0 is the backend default and eta=0 reproduces the ode path exactly, which makes A/B comparison easy. Recommended: 0-1; above 1 visibly amplifies preview noise and is experiment-only.
sample_seed: Preview seed; fixing it makes cross-step comparisons fair. Recommended: 0 randomizes each time.
sample_smoothcache_error_threshold: Reuse cache only when inter-block error is under this. Recommended: keep 0.08.
sample_smoothcache_warmup_steps: No skipping during warm-up steps. Recommended: keep 2.
sample_spectrum_probe: Diagnostic probe for Spectrum block-cache extrapolation, independent of the preview seam. Diagnostic use.
sample_spectrum_stop_caching_step: -1 never stops early; >=0 halts caching at that step. Recommended: keep -1.
sample_spectrum_warmup_steps: Warm-up steps before extrapolation engages. Recommended: keep 6.
sample_spectrum_window_size: Spectrum history window size. Recommended: keep 2.
sample_steps: Preview sampling steps. Recommended: ~24; affects preview speed/quality only.
sample_tgate_min_block: Blocks below this index are never skipped. Recommended: keep 0.
sample_tgate_probe: T-GATE cross-attn reuse probe for diagnostics.
sample_tgate_skip: Actually reuses cross-attn outputs to skip compute; validate the probe first.
sample_tgate_start_step: Sampling step from which reuse is considered. Recommended: keep 0.
sample_width: Recommended: preview width in px (multiple of 64); match training resolution or halve for speed.
samples_dir: Optional; produces the base sample-file report.
save_every_n_epochs: Save a checkpoint every N epochs. Recommended: 1-5; mutually exclusive with step-based saving.
save_every_n_steps: Save every N steps. Recommended: 500-2000; mutually exclusive with epoch saving.
save_last_n_epochs: Keep only the latest N epoch checkpoints to protect disk. Recommended: 1-3.
save_last_n_epochs_state: Keep the latest N resumable states (large, includes optimizer). Recommended: 1.
save_last_n_steps: Keep only the latest N step checkpoints. Recommended: 1-3.
save_last_n_steps_state: Keep the latest N step-based resumable states. Recommended: 1.
save_model_as: Artifact container format. safetensors is safe and fast (recommended); ckpt for legacy tooling. This is the LoRA/dense container, not Comfy INT8 adapters.
save_n_epoch_ratio: Save N evenly spaced checkpoints across training for later picking. Recommended: 2-4.
save_precision: Checkpoint precision: auto follows base/mixed precision; float is safest. Compressed bases still export high precision after dequant. Keep auto.
save_state: Also persist optimizer state for resume (2-3x model size). Enable for long jobs; disable to save disk on short ones.
save_state_on_train_end: Persist a final resumable state at train end. Enable if you may continue from the endpoint.
sc_content_dropout: Dropout probability for content tokens in the caption policy; not user-facing.
sc_locked_tags: Tags exempted from caption dropout and shuffling; not user-facing.
sc_modifier_dropout: Dropout probability for modifier tokens in the caption policy; not user-facing.
sc_quality_dropout: Stochastic quality dropout rate for SC / curriculum paths.
sc_style_dropout: Dropout probability for style tokens in the caption policy; not user-facing.
sc_trigger_dropout: Dropout probability for trigger tokens in the caption policy; not user-facing.
scale_guidance_mode: One-knob scale-focus guidance; off by default, choose a tier when composition needs biasing.
scale_v_pred_loss_like_noise_pred: Rescales v-pred loss to noise-pred magnitude for consistent scale. Keep on (default) for v-pred runs.
scale_weight_norms: Max-norm (spectral-norm-style) regularization on LoRA weights. Recommended: 1 if used; 0/empty disables.
schema_id: UI schema identifier used when matching restored legacy configs; not user-facing.
sdpa: Force PyTorch SDPA attention as an override. Off by default.
sdpa_backend_policy: Inner SDPA backend policy; applies only when SDPA is chosen. cutlass default works well.
sds_lora_clear_optimizer_state: Clears optimizer momentum at re-parameterization to avoid stale bias. Keep true.
sds_lora_enabled: SDS-LoRA produces isotropic gradients via dual branches with SVD re-parameterization after warmup. Experimental.
sds_lora_refresh_phases: Number of QR refresh phases across the run. Recommended: keep 5.
sds_lora_warmup_steps: Plain-LoRA warmup steps before re-parameterization. Recommended: keep 10.
sdxl_block_swap_enabled: Fallback toggle moving some SDXL U-Net blocks to CPU under VRAM pressure. Usually covered by the low-VRAM profile.
sdxl_block_swap_input_blocks: Input blocks last: low benefit, high slowdown. Keep false by default.
sdxl_block_swap_middle_block: Swaps the middle block next. Keep true.
sdxl_block_swap_offload_after_backward: Offload swapped blocks right after backward: saves more VRAM, runs slower. Keep on except at the extreme.
sdxl_block_swap_output_blocks: Swaps output blocks first: best benefit/speed trade. Keep true.
sdxl_block_swap_vram_threshold: Soft VRAM watermark (%) for swap decisions. Recommended: ~70; 0 offloads eagerly.
sdxl_low_vram_auto_protection: On preview OOM: throttle first, then disable preview automatically. Keep on.
sdxl_low_vram_auto_resolution_probe: Probes VRAM before launch and steps resolution down if needed. Keep on.
sdxl_low_vram_bucket_reso_steps: Bucket granularity in low-VRAM mode. Recommended: 32.
sdxl_low_vram_component_cpu_residency: VAE/TE visit GPU only when needed. Keep on (profile default).
sdxl_low_vram_fixed_block_swap: U-Net block swap inside the low-VRAM profile. Keep on (profile default).
sdxl_low_vram_optimization: One-click <=6GB bundle combining swaps, CPU residency, throttled preview. For 6-8 GB cards.
sdxl_low_vram_preview_policy: Preview cadence under low VRAM. Keep the default throttle.
sdxl_low_vram_resolution_mode: Whether/how resolution may be reduced under low VRAM. Keep auto.
sdxl_low_vram_swap_input_blocks: Input-block swap adds savings with real slowdown. Only if still OOM.
sdxl_low_vram_swap_middle_block: Middle-block swap is usually worthwhile. Keep true.
sdxl_low_vram_swap_offload_after_backwar: Move swapped blocks back right after backward: leaner, slower. Keep true.
sdxl_low_vram_swap_vram_threshold: Recommended: soft VRAM watermark; 0 offloads eagerly (profile default).
sdxl_low_vram_two_phase_cache: Two-phase cache build for SDXL low-VRAM (encode then train).
sdxl_unet_backend: SDXL U-Net execution backend; diffusers is the stable default, alternatives are performance experiments.
seed: Random seed: fixed values make data order/init/noise reproducible; -1 randomizes. Recommended: fix during development and for release runs.
sfad_drop_strength: Exponent mapping frequency to drop rate; 0 is near-uniform. Recommended: keep 1.
sfad_enabled: SFAD scales tag dropout by frequency: common tags dropped more, rare ones protected. Helps skewed tag distributions.
sfad_trigger_protect: Floor of drop rate applied to protected triggers. Recommended: 0 (never drop) up to 0.3.
sfad_warmup_steps: Recommended: ramp-in steps for protection strength; 0 applies immediately.
shuffle_caption: Shuffles comma-separated tags each read so the model never relies on positions. Enable for nearly all tag-style captions (community standard).
shuffle_caption_tags_only: Shuffle only the tags array of structured JSON while keeping NL sentences intact. Enable for dual-channel JSON labels.
sigma_depth_schedule_alpha: Sigmoid steepness of depth-vs-sigma mapping. Recommended: keep 8.
sigma_depth_schedule_beta: Center of the sigmoid in RF sigma. Recommended: keep 0.35.
sigma_depth_schedule_enabled: Depth scheduling by sample sigma; skipped blocks pass through identity without breaking grads. Orthogonal to Aircon.
sigma_depth_schedule_mode: Hard depth cap vs probabilistic skipping. hard_depth is more predictable.
sigmoid_scale: Scale of the sigmoid timestep compression. Recommended: keep 1.0; only sigmoid-style samplers read it.
skip_until_initial_step: When on, samples before initial_step are truly skipped instead of just renumbered. Enable only to realign a resumed run.
smart_noise_enabled: Smart Noise Scheduler focuses sampling on a logSNR band. Keep off unless targeting a specific detail/structure band.
smart_noise_focus_spread: Width (std) of the Gaussian focus in logSNR units. Recommended: 0.5-5 (default 2).
smart_noise_focus_strength: Focus intensity 0-1; higher concentrates sampling. Recommended: 0.3-0.7.
smart_noise_logsnr_focus: Center of the focus band in logSNR. Recommended: probe within -3..3; 0 is midpoint.
smart_rank_enabled: SmartRank adjusts effective rank within [min,max] periodically. Capacity-adaptive experiment.
smart_rank_interval: Evaluation cadence in steps. Recommended: keep 50.
smart_rank_max: Recommended: dynamic rank ceiling; within ~2x network_dim.
softrepa_enabled: SoftREPA ramps alignment strength over a schedule; compare head-to-head with plain REPA.
softrepa_max_weight: Schedule ending weight. Recommended: at most about 1.
softrepa_min_weight: Schedule starting weight. Recommended: ramp from 0.
softrepa_schedule: How weight follows progress; linear works well.
softrepa_sigma_max: Upper bound of the sigma window. Recommended: 1 covers all.
softrepa_sigma_min: Lower bound of the alignment sigma window. Recommended: 0 covers all.
spd_enabled: SPD multi-resolution preview sampling touches only the sampler path, never training loss. Off by default.
spd_resize_mode: Latent interpolation mode for SPD. bilinear default is fine.
spd_scale_factors: Comma-separated resolution scale factors for progressive preview, for example 0.5,1.0.
spd_steps_per_level: Comma-separated step counts per resolution level; empty splits the total preview steps automatically.
split_attn: Splits attention across heads to trim VRAM at slight speed cost. Try when marginal on memory.
sra2_haste_base_weight: Base weight of the alignment loss. Recommended: keep 1.
sra2_haste_capture_layers: Comma-separated module-name suffixes whose activations are captured.
sra2_haste_decay_end_step: Recommended: step where decay reaches min weight; pairs with decay start.
sra2_haste_decay_start_step: Step where decay begins; -1 disables decay. Recommended: keep -1.
sra2_haste_enabled: SRA2-HASTE aligns mid-layer representations with an adaptive schedule; choose one family among alignment aids.
sra2_haste_loss_type: Alignment loss type; cosine is robust.
sra2_haste_min_relative_improvement: Minimum relative improvement counted. Recommended: keep 0.
sra2_haste_normalize_targets: Normalizes targets before aligning. Keep true.
sra2_haste_plateau_patience: Patience for plateau early-stop; 0 disables. Recommended: keep 0.
sra2_haste_start_step: First step the loss applies. Recommended: keep 0.
sra2_haste_stop_grad_target: Stops gradient into the target side. Keep true.
sra2_haste_stop_step: -1 runs to completion; >=0 stops there. Recommended: keep -1.
staged_resolution_ratio_1024: Recommended: share (%) of the 1024 tier used by both 1024/2048 pipelines.
staged_resolution_ratio_1536: Recommended: share (%) of the 1536 tier, only under the 2048 pipeline.
staged_resolution_ratio_2048: Recommended: share (%) of the 2048 tier, only under the 2048 pipeline.
staged_resolution_ratio_512: Recommended: share (%) of 512-tier samples in staged-resolution training; ratios should sum to 100.
staged_resolution_ratio_768: Recommended: share (%) of the 768 tier; ignored below that edge.
step_phase_profile_enabled: Profiles per-phase step timings for performance work.
stepped_loss_enabled: Switches loss type/weights by step schedule. For staged experiments.
stepped_loss_schedule: Stage table for stepped losses. Start with two simple stages.
steps: Recommended: total distillation steps; start at ordinary LoRA scale then tune.
stochastic_depth_decay: Decay schedule for stochastic depth survival probability.
stochastic_depth_enabled: Randomly skips DiT blocks during training for speed plus regularization. Watch convergence when enabled.
stochastic_depth_min_blocks_kept: Leading blocks never skipped. Recommended: keep 4.
student_scheduler: Few-step sampler for the student. lcm recommended.
student_steps: Target few-step count. Recommended: 4; lower is harder to align.
swap_count: Absolute swapped-block count overriding ratio when >0. Recommended: prefer ratio; set exact counts only for precise control.
swap_granularity: Master switch for weight swapping between CPU and GPU by block or layer granularity. Try block-level first under VRAM pressure.
swap_ratio: Fraction of blocks swapped (0-1). Recommended: probe from 0.3-0.5 alongside the watermark control.
sync_asset_keys: Asset path keys back-filled from the main node, comma-separated. The default covers base model, dataset, regularization, VAE and resume paths.
sync_config_from_main: Workers pull training config from the master. Keep on.
sync_config_keys_from_main: Top-level config keys pulled from the main node, comma-separated; * syncs everything. Narrow the list when workers need local overrides.
sync_main_toml: Path to the TOML the main node publishes for workers to sync from.
sync_missing_assets_from_main: Workers fetch missing models/data from the master on demand. Keep on without shared storage.
sync_ssh_password: SSH password for remote sync. Prefer an environment variable, key-based auth or a shared path, since this value is stored with the config.
sync_ssh_port: SSH port for remote sync. Recommended: keep default 22 unless your server differs.
sync_ssh_user: SSH user used for remote sync.
sync_use_password_auth: Password auth for remote sync (vs key auth). Prefer keys; beware credential exposure.
system_prompt: System prompt prepended by the Lumina text encoder. Leave empty to use the model default.
t5_max_token_length: Max T5 tokens. Recommended: 512; up to 768 for long captions at double cache cost.
t5xxl_max_token_length: Max T5-XXL tokens. Recommended: 256-512; lower when VRAM-bound.
tag_group_separator: Boundary for in-group shuffle (default |||). May match the scope separator.
tag_group_shuffle: Shuffle tags within groups split by separator; replaces global shuffle when on. Stacks with after_separator on the mutable region.
target_dims: Score dimensions participating in training, one per line.
target_image_path: ADDifT Target Image. And Original Image Resolution.
target_modules: Target module selection for LyCORIS. Keep the default full set; narrow it for debugging.
target_prompt: Prompt describing the target concept. Leaving it empty biases iLECO toward erasing the source concept instead of remapping it.
tc_lora_cond_channels: Channels of condition latents/control. Recommended: match your conditioning; default 16.
tc_lora_cond_dim: Width of the global condition code. Recommended: keep 64.
tc_lora_condition_enabled: Enable the condition-y encoder for extra conditioning inputs. Only with control inputs.
tc_lora_enabled: TC-LoRA generates LoRA weights via a timestep-conditioned hypernetwork: adaptive but heavier to train.
tc_lora_generation_mode: Generation gating mode; only gated is supported now. Keep gated.
te_vae_offload_strategy: When TE/VAE occupy GPU across the run lifecycle; phased residency is the default.
teacher_lora_scope: Which parts load teacher LoRA weights; unet_only avoids polluting targets via TE.
teacher_path: Optional; explicitly points at a teacher model resource.
teacher_scheduler: Teacher sampler; dpmpp_2m_karras gives strong targets.
teacher_steps: Teacher sampling steps. Recommended: ~30; higher costs more.
tensorring_factor: 2-mode decomposition size; 0 auto-picks from in/out GCD. Recommended: keep 0.
tensorring_lora_enabled: Tensor-Ring LoRA with single-step fused decomposition W*=W0T+delta. Validate on small runs first.
tensorring_tr_rank: TensorRing residual rank; 0 disables the branch. Recommended: keep 0.
tensorring_trm_rank: TRM transform rank; 0 or <=rank degrades to low-rank I+UV form. Recommended: keep 0.
text_encoder: Qwen Image Text Encoder Path, Empty Etc. After
text_encoder_batch_size: Batch size for TE cache encoding. Recommended: 1-8, halve when VRAM-bound.
text_encoder_cpu: Keep text encoder on CPU to save VRAM (slower TE path).
text_encoder_lr: Standalone text-encoder LR; lower values preserve pretrained semantics while adapting trigger words. Recommended: 1/2 to 1/10 of UNet LR (backend default 5e-5), or 0 to freeze TE.
text_encoder_outputs_cache_disk_dtype: On-disk dtype for TE outputs. float16 balances size and fidelity.
text_encoder_outputs_cache_disk_format: Container format for the TE-output disk cache. npz recommended.
text_encoder_outputs_cache_dtype: In-memory dtype for cached TE outputs. fp16 recommended; float32 if artifacts appear.
thin_svd_export_enabled: Compress LoRA via target-rank SVD at save time. Keep off by default; RS-LoRA skips automatically.
thin_svd_export_rank: Target rank for Thin-SVD export, below original dim; 0/empty disables. Recommended: use for archival distribution only.
thunder_jit_cache_enabled: Caches keyed by model/dtype/rank/shape/executor/RNG contract. Keep true.
thunder_jit_cache_root: Cache root for Thunder artifacts on a fast disk.
thunder_jit_enabled: Legacy Thunder master switch kept for old configs; use the execution-backend selector instead. Keep false.
thunder_jit_executors: Thunder executor set; nvfuser+sdpa is the recommended pairing, torchcompile executor stays experimental.
thunder_jit_progress_enabled: Shows compile progress, cache hits and partial fallbacks. Keep on for visibility.
thunder_jit_warmup_enabled: Pre-compiles representative shapes before training. Enable once; caches cover later runs.
tiered_residency_spill_active_eviction: Returns host pages right after upload, avoiding pagefile churn and SSD wear. Enable alongside spilling.
tiered_residency_spill_allow_backbone: Lets DiT blocks actually spill: the main RAM win. Without it savings are marginal.
tiered_residency_spill_allow_text_encode: Includes TE weights in spilling; cheap since reads are rare. Keep true.
tiered_residency_spill_allow_vae: Includes VAE weights; touched only during encode/decode. Keep true.
tiered_residency_spill_cleanup: Deletes spill files at train end or leaves GBs behind. Keep true.
tiered_residency_spill_enabled: Spills frozen-base masters to disk trading RAM for IO (~1.9x step time measured on Anima). Enable only as a last resort on RAM-starved machines.
tiered_residency_spill_min_free_gb: Free GB the disk must keep; otherwise fall back to RAM. Recommended: 4-16 by drive size.
tiered_residency_spill_page_lookahead: Blocks of read-ahead for page faults. Recommended: 2-4.
tiered_residency_spill_prefer_copy: Copies slow-disk models onto the fast spill drive once instead of reading the slow disk every block. Only for that scenario.
tiered_residency_spill_root: Spill folder: NVMe SSD strongly advised; HDD/USB always loses. Empty uses system temp.
timestep_sampling: Diffusion timestep distribution (shift/logit_normal/uniform...). shift suits most flow models.
timestep_sampling_mode: Aux switch over timestep-sampling modes; disabled keeps standard behavior.
timestep_segments: Segment configuration for piecewise timestep sampling.
timestep_weighting_enabled: Weights per-sample loss by diffusion timestep; multiplies with region/noise/difficulty axes. Use to bias structure vs detail deliberately.
timestep_weighting_lut_id: Optional asset id for the timestep calibration table; an explicit path takes precedence.
timestep_weighting_mode: Timestep tilt direction (low-noise detail vs high-noise structure; offline-calibrated LUT). Start uniform.
timestep_weighting_strength: Timestep-weight strength: 0 identity, 1 standard tilt, cap 4. Recommended: 0.25-1 when combined.
tlora_min_rank: Dynamic rank lower bound for T-LoRA. Recommended: keep 1.
tlora_orthogonal_init: Orthogonal init for lora_down improves early stability. Off by default; try when unstable.
tlora_rank_schedule: Dynamic-rank schedule (constant/linear/geometric per backend). Start with constant.
lora2_enabled: LoRA2: two learnable gated branches synthesize the delta (gate_init sets the initial gate); separate family from LoRA2 Adaptive. Experimental route.
token_string: New token absent from the tokenizer.
torch_compile: Legacy torch.compile switch kept for old configs; use the execution-backend selector instead. Keep false.
torch_compile_allow_full_with_per_block: Expert: permit full+per_block coexistence without guard. Keep false.
torch_compile_dynamic: Allows dynamic shapes trading some optimization for stability. Prefer true.
torch_compile_fallback_enabled: On: compile failure falls back to eager with a warning log. Off: compile failure raises immediately (fail-fast) instead of silently falling back.
torch_compile_fullgraph: Demands one break-free graph, falling back otherwise. Keep false for tolerance.
torch_compile_mode: torch.compile mode: default balanced, reduce-overhead trims startup, max-autotune fastest steady-state but slowest first pass. Keep default.
torch_compile_scope: Compile scope: empty follows runtime; per_block or full override. Leave empty.
train_batch_size: Images processed per forward/backward pass; drives VRAM and gradient smoothness. Recommended: 1 when VRAM-bound, up to 2 for SDXL 1024px on 24 GB; scale effective batch with grad accumulation.
train_data_dir: Dataset root: each subfolder is one concept named repeats@concept (e.g. 10_lulu). Prefer an SSD for speed.
train_length_mode: End training by max epochs or max steps; only one applies. Use epochs for small concept sets, steps for precise budgets on larger libraries.
train_norm: Also train normalization layers (LayerNorm/RMSNorm). Try for character fidelity; keep off normally.
train_quant_preset: : To weight_compression_preset. Recommended stable_backbone_int8; off=. And keep_w8.
train_t5xxl: Training T5-XXL Text Encoder (Not Recommended, VRAM Overhead Very Large)
train_text_encoder: Fine-tune the CLIP text encoder as well (runtime-default semantics); off trains U-Net/DiT only. Enable when trigger-word binding is weak and set TE LR to 1/2-1/10 of UNet.
training_intent: Pick an intent to preview suggestions first; only clicking "Apply unset items" writes to the draft, explicitly modified fields are never overwritten.
training_quantization_enabled: Alias entry mirroring quantization_enabled. Prefer the primary switch.
training_quantization_type: Alias of the main quantization-type field. Recommended: mirror the primary switch and leave this alone.
training_type: Training-form identifier (lora, finetune and so on) forwarded to the backend; fixed per schema and not user-facing.
training_vram_profile: Declares a target VRAM tier to the submit pipeline; honored per family based on evidence. Pick your actual tier conservatively.
training_vram_profile_control: Marks whether the VRAM profile manages the derived knobs; managed means the profile owns them. Not user-facing.
trajectory_mix_ratio: Share of each micro-batch that uses the trajectory objective; the remainder falls back to the standard distillation objective. 0.0 is a meaningful setting (pure standard, where the trajectory path is still parsed and validated but contributes nothing) and is not the same as leaving the key unset, since 0 is forwarded verbatim to the backend resolver. Recommended: 1.0 for full coverage, 0.5 for controlled comparison.
trajectory_sparse_steps: Number of Euler points K walked along the trajectory when trajectory_variant is sparse, which sets both the forward-pass count and the activation footprint. Recommended: 4-8, floor 2.
trajectory_variant: Shape of the two-step trajectory research objective: two_step stitches one jump with a straight-through connector (2 forward passes, default), while sparse walks K detached Euler points along the model own trajectory with no connector (K forward passes and K activation sets) for denser supervision at a real cost. Keep two_step; choose sparse with sparse_steps at 4-8 when you want dense on-trajectory supervision.
triton_ops_enabled: Off by default. Attempts LTX Triton injection only when the QKV sub-switch is also on.
triton_ops_inject_qkv: Standard video attn1 only; Perturbed, cross, and audio paths are skipped. When co-enabled with physical packing Triton hits first and misses fall back to the physical path.
trust_remote_code: Allows repo-provided custom code execution in transformers/diffusers. Security-sensitive: trusted sources only.
tuneqdm_enabled: Experimental (ECCV 2024 TuneQDM): keep INT8 weights frozen and train only the dequant scales; stacks with LoRA or works alone. Requires the keep_w8 INT8 base (Keep INT8 Frozen Training), otherwise skipped. Trained scales are saved as a .tuneqdm_scales.safetensors sidecar next to the checkpoint. Synthetic validation passed; real-run quality not yet signed off.
tuneqdm_warmup_steps: Linear LR warmup (0->1 multiplier) for scale groups protecting quantized bases; 0 disables. Recommended: keep 500.
turbo_lora_acceptance_threshold_high: Acceptance threshold at the high-noise end; larger is looser. Recommended: keep 0.5.
turbo_lora_acceptance_threshold_low: Acceptance threshold at the low-noise end; smaller is stricter. Recommended: keep 0.02.
turbo_lora_distill_cosine_weight: Cosine-direction term weight in distillation (0 = pure MSE). Recommended: keep 0.1.
turbo_lora_distill_trajectory_ratio: Fraction sampled along the late ODE trajectory. Recommended: keep 0.5.
turbo_lora_draft_hidden_dim: Draft hidden width (~half of target by default). Recommended: keep 512.
turbo_lora_draft_num_layers: Draft DiT depth (default 8); smaller is faster. Recommended: keep 8.
turbo_lora_draft_steps: Speculative draft steps per cycle. Recommended: 3-5.
turbo_lora_enabled: TurboLoRA Phase-1 draft contract: initializes the draft net and teacher packet only; full distillation/acceleration is not wired yet. Experimental observation only.
turbocore_data_pipeline_enabled: Routes caption loading through the Rust decode pipeline to ease CPU/IO bottlenecks; independent of the optimizer switch.
turbocore_disable: Hard-disable TurboCore even if the top bar requests it.
turbocore_enabled: Master switch: routes the optimizer step through CUDA/Triton accelerated kernels; off = standard PyTorch path. When on, Optimizer Backend is hidden and the Lulynx Triton optimizer is forced off.
turbocore_mode: Requires the TurboCore master switch above.
turbocore_optimizer_mode: Lulynx Triton optimizer level: off stock PyTorch, auto decides, force errors out if unsupported (requires the TurboCore CUDA master switch off). Start with auto.
turbocore_prefetch_depth: Prefetch queue depth (default 2); deeper hides latency but costs VRAM. Recommended: 2-4.
turbocore_profile: TurboCore profile: basic default; fast couples Vortex Aircon and fused optimizer automatically. Start basic.
turbocore_strict: Error instead of silently falling back when optimized kernels fail. On for debugging, off otherwise.
turbocore_tuned_kernel_disable: Global kill-switch for autotuned TurboCore kernels. Keep false.
turbocore_workspace_mb: Kernel workspace cap in MB; 0 allocates automatically. Recommended: keep 0.
twinflow_adversarial_enabled: Self-adversarial branch (one-step EMA fake, L_adv, rectify): notably slower, no external discriminator. Off by default.
twinflow_adversarial_weight: L_adv weight; needs the branch on and >0 to enter loss. Recommended: start 0.
twinflow_enabled: EMA-of-LoRA teacher + RCGM/real-velocity. Before VRAM;. And distillation (When distillation).
twinflow_enhanced_ratio: CFG-refine ratio; MVP default 0 skips extra forwards. Recommended: keep 0.
twinflow_estimate_order: RCGM estimation order; >=2 adds a teacher forward. Recommended: keep 2.
twinflow_rectify_weight: Rectify alignment weight (real side detached). Recommended: start 0.
twinflow_target_clamp: Absolute clamp on RCGM targets; 0 disables clamping. Recommended: keep 1.
twinflow_target_step_count: Narrative few-step metadata (does not swap the product sampler). Recommended: keep 2.
twinflow_weight: TwinFlow aux-loss master gate; effective above 0 (try 0.5-1.0). Recommended: experimental paths only.
ui_custom_params: Danger: raw TOML merged last, overriding whatever the UI produced. Use only for keys the UI does not expose, and re-check preflight afterwards.
unbalanced_factorization: Swap which LoKr side gets factorized, changing parameter shape. Experimental; keep off.
unet_lr: U-Net/DiT learning rate override. Recommended: same as base LR (1e-4 scale for LoRA).
unet_path: SDXL UNet, checkpoint Or diffusers Model Path.
universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv: When On By Layer Linear, q/k/v slice adapter.
universal_dit_allow_remote_download: Allows base_model_path to resolve remote repositories; prefer downloading and verifying via Resource Center or locally first.
universal_dit_enabled: DiT/Transformer Static, Auto Linear target LoRA.
universal_dit_forward_mapping_json: Optional. Explicit mapping (JSON object) for cache-to-forward parameter name mismatches; leave empty to infer from probing.
universal_dit_objective_template: Objective template for Universal DiT; auto requires confirmation when evidence is thin rather than guessing.
universal_dit_output_selector_json: Optional. Required when the forward returns multiple tensors: pick the training target output, e.g. {"index":0} or {"key":"sample"}.
universal_dit_probe_mode: Probing depth for Universal DiT; train_smoke adds a minimal backward pass. auto suffices usually.
universal_dit_target_modules_json: Only explicit Strategy, ["blocks.0.attn.to_q", "blocks.0.mlp.fc1"]. Path In As nn.Linear.
universal_dit_target_policy: Which Linears become targets: the conservative attention+MLP set, all Linears, or an explicit whitelist. Keep attention_mlp.
universal_dit_trust_remote_code: Honors repo-provided custom code. High risk; enable only for reviewed, trusted sources. Default off.
up_lr_weight: Per-layer LR weights for the decoder section, 0-1.
use_cache: Reuse previously built latent/text-conditioning caches instead of keeping VAE/Qwen3 resident. Keep true (default) while data is unchanged; rebuild after dataset/caption edits.
use_lora: Train as LoRA instead of full finetune (lora_rank remaps to network_dim).
v2: Declare the base model as SD 2.x architecture (affects tokenizer/padding and v-prediction). Enable only for actual SD2.x checkpoints; keep false otherwise.
v_parameterization: v-prediction mode: predict v=noise-latent instead of noise; required by some SD2.x checkpoints. Follow your base model; keep off when unsure.
vae_batch_size: Batch size for VAE cache encoding; 0 auto. Recommended: 4-16, halve on OOM.
vae_chunk_size: VAE decode chunk size; smaller saves more VRAM. Recommended: ~2.
vae_slicing: Slices VAE encode/decode to cut peak VRAM. Enable when the VAE stage OOMs at high resolution.
vae_tiling: Tiles the VAE for very large images. Enable beyond the VAE design size (e.g. >2048 on SDXL).
val_data_dir: Validation Image Directory. Empty When Fallback As Training Directory
val_ratio: Validation split when the split field path is unused. Recommended: ~0.1.
validate_every_n_epochs: Run validation every N epochs. Recommended: align with saving cadence (1-5).
validate_every_n_steps: Run validation every N steps. Recommended: 500-2000; too frequent slows runs.
validation_seed: Seed for the validation split so it stays identical across runs. Recommended: fix it for comparability.
validation_split: Fraction held out for validation. Recommended: 0.05-0.2 (<0.05 warns); 0 disables.
vera_d_initial: Initial value of VeRA learnable scaling vector. Recommended: keep 0.1.
