vera_enabled: VeRA shares frozen random matrices with tiny learnable vectors: far fewer params than LoRA with lower ceiling. For ultra-light adapters.
vera_prng_key: PRNG seed for VeRA shared matrices; must match to load/reproduce. Recommended: keep 0.
vortex_budget_mb: Recommended: vortex cache budget in MB; probe upward from 256.
vortex_enabled: Vortex VRAM manager master switch. Off by default; enable for its planning features.
vortex_low_vram_min_free_mb: Minimum free VRAM (MB) before protection engages. Recommended: 512-2048 by card size.
vortex_low_vram_prefetch_throttle: Low VRAM When Prefetch Depth, Prefetch VRAM. Default Enable.
vortex_low_vram_protection_enabled: Arms Vortex protection below the free-VRAM watermark. Pair with the threshold field.
vortex_low_vram_protection_mode: Protection mode; observe logs only. Keep observe.
vortex_mode: observe/planner modes never alter tensor paths. Start with observe.
vortex_strategy: Strategy name handed to Vortex. Keep standard.
vram_auto_enhance_enabled: Auto-enables block checkpointing and friends when VRAM runs short. Keep on (default) for hands-free relief.
vram_auto_tier: Auto tiers T1-T3 writing compression/companion knobs heuristically; goal is train-without-OOM. Manual first; emergency from T1.
vram_auto_tier_force_extreme: Permit tier T3 extremes (otherwise capped at T2). Accept the heavy slowdown before enabling.
vram_smart_sensing_baseline_steps: Steps used to build the speed baseline. Recommended: 50.
vram_smart_sensing_delta_cache_enabled: Read-only detection of PCIe delta/cache candidates; no allocation happens. Keep on for reports.
vram_smart_sensing_enabled: Smart sensing builds a speed baseline and proposes candidate optimizations when things slow down. Run it on new setups.
vram_smart_sensing_slowdown_ratio: Slow-down multiple that triggers advice. Recommended: 1.5.
vram_smart_sensing_sparse_swap_enabled: Allow sparse swap among reported candidates. Keep on.
vram_smart_sensing_streaming_enabled: Allow streaming offload among candidates. Keep on.
vram_smart_sensing_window_steps: Sliding window for slow-down detection. Recommended: 5.
vram_swap_to_ram: Keeps trainable weights of native variants in host RAM, uploading on demand. Try when optimizer state blows past VRAM.
wan22_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Wan2.2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
wan22_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Wan2.2 block offload.
wan22_block_residency: Residency policy for Wan2.2 transformer blocks: resident keeps them on GPU, block_offload streams them adaptively. Keep block_offload for the larger towers.
wan22_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleaves copies of Wan2.2 TI2V-5B blocks (self-attention, cross-attention and FFN output projections zeroed) so the inserted layers start as identity residuals. Single-tower TI2V-5B only, the A14B dual tower is unsupported; the run saves a complete new base model.
wan22_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total transformer blocks after expansion. Recommended: above the native 30 of TI2V-5B, for example 38.
wan22_depth_expansion_train_scope: Trains the inserted layers only, the inserted layers plus the input/time/output periphery, or every parameter. new_layers is the conservative default.
wan22_discrete_flow_shift: Discrete-flow sampling shift for Wan2.2. Recommended: around 5.0 for TI2V/I2V and 12.0 for T2V, following the checkpoint family.
wan22_expert_timestep_preset: Default off. Restricts timestep sampling prior to the selected noise tower sigma interval (high to [875,1000), low to [0,875)).
wan22_fps: Metadata frame rate stored in the cache fingerprint; does not change sampling.
wan22_frame_stride: Source-video frame gap between sampled frames.
wan22_model_variant: Wan2.2 variant selection determining weight layout and cache format; match your checkpoint exactly.
wan22_noise_stage: High/low noise stage split across the paired experts; dictated by your checkpoint pair.
wan22_target_frames: Training clip target frames; keep 1 for single-image training.
wan22_timestep_sampling: Wan2.2 timestep sampling distribution; the shift family default fits most runs.
wandb_api_key: W&B API key, required only when log_with=wandb. Keep secret; never commit.
wandb_run_name: Display name of a single wandb run.
wavelet_loss_approx_weight: Weight on the coarsest LL band. Recommended: keep 0 unless large-scale structure needs extra constraint.
wavelet_loss_base_loss: Base loss inside the wavelet domain. l2 default.
wavelet_loss_detail_boost: Recommended: extra high-frequency boost during detail phase; 0 off to start.
wavelet_loss_enabled: Adds multi-scale wavelet losses beside pixel space to steady structure and lift detail.
wavelet_loss_levels: Wavelet levels; higher biases large structures. Recommended: range 1-4.
wavelet_loss_sigma_gate: Sigma below which high-frequency weighting saturates. Recommended: keep 0.5.
wavelet_loss_weight: Overall wavelet weight. Recommended: start small: 0.02-0.1.
weight_compression_enabled: Manual entry for weight compression bypassing presets; use the preset row instead unless fine-tuning knobs.
weight_compression_exclude_patterns: Optional, comma-separated; matching components/parameters are not compressed.
weight_compression_format: Compression format: fp8_e4m3 is the stable native path; torchao/quanto need their runtimes installed.
weight_compression_include_patterns: Optional, comma-separated; only matching components/parameters are compressed.
weight_compression_preset: One-click compression preset picking format/target/verify automatically. Start here before manual tuning.
weight_compression_target: What gets compressed: backbone, text_encoder, or both. Compress backbone first to protect TE precision.
weight_compression_verify: Numeric spot-checks after compression (reconstruction error). Enable the first time you compress a given base.
weight_decay: AdamW-family L2 regularization limiting weight growth. Recommended: 0.01 (default); Prodigy/DAdaptation manage their own and accept 0.
weighted_captions: Parse (tag:1.2) weight syntax in captions. Enable only if captions actually use weighted syntax.
weighting_scheme: Loss weighting scheme over timesteps (logit_normal, mode, cosine, cosmap or none). Fixed per family; not user-facing.
workers: Data-loading worker processes. Recommended: 4-8 on a typical desktop; drop to 0 when debugging loader errors.
wv3_head_path: Waifu Scorer v3 Weight Path. Empty When Auto Path
xformers: Force xformers memory-efficient attention as an override; mostly a legacy-GPU fallback.
zero_terminal_snr: Zeroes terminal SNR to improve contrast in v-pred models. Use only with v-prediction training; keep off for eps models.
zimage_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Z-Image blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
zimage_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Z-Image block offload.
zimage_block_offload_ratio: Share of Z-Image blocks eligible for offload. Recommended: 100 or 0; partial values rarely pay off.
zimage_block_residency: Residency policy for Z-Image blocks: resident keeps them on GPU, block_offload streams them adaptively. Keep block_offload on 6B bases.
zimage_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleaves copies of Z-Image backbone layer blocks (attention output projection and FFN w2 zeroed) so the inserted layers start as identity residuals; refiner layers are excluded and the run saves a complete new base model.
zimage_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total backbone transformer blocks after expansion. Recommended: above the native 30 of Z-Image 6B, for example 38.
zimage_depth_expansion_train_scope: Trains the inserted layers only, the inserted layers plus the input/time/output periphery, or every parameter. new_layers is the conservative default.
zimage_discrete_flow_shift: Discrete-flow sampling shift for Z-Image. Recommended: keep the 2.0 default unless the checkpoint documents otherwise.
zimage_timestep_sampling: ZImage timestep sampling distribution. Keep the default.
